# Übersicht

Dieses Dokument integriert klinische Variablen (Demografie, Komorbiditäten, Echo-Parameter, Risiko-Scores) mit den RNA-seq-Daten aus `DEanalysis.qmd`.

**Ziel:** Identifikation klinischer Assoziationen mit molekularen Signaturen (GSVA-Scores) unter Berücksichtigung methodischer Robustheit und Reviewer-Anforderungen.

**Methodische Basis:**
- Schmader et al. 2021 (BMC Cardiovasc Disord): Baseline-Inflammation → TAVR-Outcomes
- Kuppe et al. 2024 (Circ Genom Precis Med): Longitudinale Immunantwort nach MI
- Hänzelmann et al. 2013 (BMC Bioinformatics): GSVA für sample-level Pathway-Scores

**Implementierungsplan:** 12-Schritte-Plan basierend auf CLINICAL_INTEGRATION_REVIEW.md

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup-packages
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Reproduzierbarkeit: Seed setzen
set.seed(42)
message("✓ Seed set to 42 for reproducibility")

# Pakete laden
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(janitor)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)     # Für df-Korrektur bei kleinen n
  library(broom.mixed)
  library(car)          # Für VIF-Berechnung
  library(effectsize)   # Für Cohen's d
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(immunedeconv)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(patchwork)
  library(immunedeconv)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(digest)
})

# Erhöhe R Expression-Limit (verhindert "infinite recursion" bei komplexen Chunks)
options(expressions = 50000)

# Sichere print-Funktion (umgeht kableExtra knit_print Override)
safe_print <- function(x, ...) {
  if (inherits(x, c("tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame"))) {
    writeLines(capture.output(base::print.data.frame(as.data.frame(x), ...)))
  } else {
    writeLines(capture.output(base::print(x, ...)))
  }
}
# === SAFETY PARAMETERS ===
  # min_n_per_group / min_n_subgroup:
  #   Stop-Regel gegen underpowered Subgruppenanalysen.
  #   Bei n<20 pro Gruppe: keine separate Inferenz, nur deskriptiv.
  #   Verhindert instabile Schätzer und falsch-positive Befunde bei kleinen Stichproben.
  #
  # vif_threshold:
  #   Schwellenwert für Multikollinearität.
  #   Modelle mit VIF>5 für einzelne Prädiktoren werden refactored.
  #   Verhindert instabile Regressionskoeffizienten bei korrelierten Prädiktoren
  #   (z.B. Euroscore + Komponenten, metabolisches Syndrom-Cluster).
  #
  # max_predictors:
  #   Events-per-Variable Regel: Bei kontinuierlichen Outcomes ~10 Beobachtungen pro Prädiktor.
  #   Bei n=46 sind max 4-5 Prädiktoren angemessen.
  #   Schützt vor Overfitting bei kleiner Stichprobe ohne externe Validierung.

# Parameter
clinical_params <- list(
  padj_cutoff = 0.05,
  min_n_per_group = 15,    # Minimum n für Interaktionsanalysen
  min_n_subgroup = 20,     # Minimum n für Subgruppenanalysen
  vif_threshold = 5,       # VIF-Schwellenwert für Kollinearität
  seed = 42,
  # Power/EPV: Bei n=46, max 3-4 Prädiktoren empfohlen
  max_predictors = 4       # Events-per-Variable Regel für kontinuierliche Outcomes
  )

# Verzeichnisse
clinical_data_dir <- "../../../dat/info_files"
clinical_cache_dir <- "../../../res/cache/clinical"
clinical_output_dir <- "../../../res/clinical"
clinical_fig_dir <- "../../../res/figures/clinical"

dir.create(clinical_cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(clinical_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(clinical_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Cache-Funktion
clinical_cache_key <- function(...) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'digest' required. Install with: install.packages('digest')")
  }
  digest::digest(list(...), algo = "xxhash64")
}

message("✓ Setup complete")
```

# SCHRITT 1: Datenimport & Encodingfix

**Ziel:** Clinical CSV mit korrektem Encoding/Locale importieren, Plausibilitätschecks durchführen


```{r}
#| label: step1-import-clinical
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 1: Clinical Data Import ===")

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_cache <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "clinical_raw.rds")


if (file.exists(clinical_cache)) {
  message("✅ Lade Clinical Cache: ", clinical_cache)
  clinical_raw <- readRDS(clinical_cache)
} else {
  message("⏳ Importiere Clinical CSV...")

  # Import mit korrektem Locale (Dezimal-Komma)
  clinical_raw <- read_delim(
    file.path(clinical_data_dir, "2026-01-03_clinical_data.csv"),
    delim = ";",
    locale = locale(decimal_mark = ",", grouping_mark = "."),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()
  
  if (!"labor_nr" %in% names(clinical_raw)) {
  stop("Expected ID column 'labor_nr' not found after clean_names(). Check clinical CSV header.")
}

  # Typ-Validierung: Numerische Spalten müssen numeric sein
  numeric_vars <- c("age", "bmi", "pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd", "log_euroscore_ii",
                    "pr_echo_ef_percent", "pr_echo_aoef")
  for (vname in numeric_vars) {
    if (vname %in% names(clinical_raw)) {
      if (!is.numeric(clinical_raw[[vname]])) {
        stop(sprintf("Variable %s ist nicht numerisch. Dezimal-Komma-Import fehlgeschlagen?", vname))
      }
    }
  }
  message("✓ Typ-Validierung: Alle numerischen Variablen korrekt importiert")

  saveRDS(clinical_raw, clinical_cache)
  message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_cache)
}

# ============================================================
# Plausibilitätschecks & Range-Validierung
# ============================================================

# === PLAUSIBILITÄTSCHECKS ===
# Range-Definitionen basieren auf klinischer Plausibilität:
#   - age: 50-100 Jahre (TAVI-Population älter)
#   - bmi: 15-50 kg/m² (Untergewicht bis Adipositas Grad III)
#   - gfr_mdrd: 10-120 ml/min (schwere Niereninsuffizienz bis Normwert)
#   - log_euroscore_ii: 0-15% (Standard-Risiko bis Extremrisiko)
#   - echo_ef: 10-80% (schwere Dysfunktion bis Normwert)
#   - echo_aoef: 0.3-2 cm² (kritische bis leichte Stenose)
#
# Abweichungen >50% von Erwartungswert führen zu Stop (Import-Fehler vermutet),
# moderate Abweichungen nur Warning (echte Extremwerte möglich).

range_checks <- list(
  age = c(50, 100),
  bmi = c(15, 50),
  pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd = c(10, 120),
  log_euroscore_ii = c(0, 15),
  pr_echo_ef_percent = c(10, 80),
  pr_echo_aoef = c(0.3, 2)
)

for (vname in names(range_checks)) {
  if (vname %in% names(clinical_raw)) {
    val_range <- range(clinical_raw[[vname]], na.rm = TRUE)
    expected  <- range_checks[[vname]]

    if (val_range[1] < expected[1] | val_range[2] > expected[2]) {
      msg <- sprintf(
        "%s: Range [%.2f, %.2f] außerhalb Plausibilitätsbereich [%.0f, %.0f]",
        vname, val_range[1], val_range[2], expected[1], expected[2]
      )
      # Bei extremen Abweichungen: Stop, sonst Warning
      if (val_range[1] < expected[1]*0.5 | val_range[2] > expected[2]*1.5) {
        stop(msg, " — Kritischer Import-Fehler")
      } else {
        warning(msg)
      }
    }
  }
}

# Extreme Werte identifizieren (für Dokumentation)
# WICHTIG: Spaltennamen nach clean_names() sind lowercase
extreme_cases <- clinical_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    bmi > 40 |
      pr_echo_ef_percent < 20 |
      log_euroscore_ii > 10
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(pid = labor_nr, age, bmi, pr_echo_ef_percent, log_euroscore_ii)

if (nrow(extreme_cases) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ Extreme Werte identifiziert (n=", nrow(extreme_cases), "):")
  print(extreme_cases)
}

# Dimensionen berichten
message("✓ Clinical data imported: ", nrow(clinical_raw), " patients × ",
        ncol(clinical_raw), " variables")
```

# SCHRITT 2: Redundanzbereinigung & Variablenerstellung

**Ziel:** Redundante Variablen entfernen, abgeleitete Variablen erstellen

**Aktionen:**
- Entferne: `male` (dupliziert `sex`)
- Nutze: `Labor_Nr` als patientenweite ID (PID) fuer den Join mit RNA-seq
- Erstelle: GFR-Kategorien, BMI-Kategorien, NYHA-Gruppierung, Metabolisches Syndrom

```{r}
#| label: step2-variable-engineering
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 2: Variable Engineering ===")

clinical_clean <- clinical_raw %>%
  # Redundanz entfernen (nach clean_names() sind alle Namen lowercase)
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("male"))) %>%

  # pid für Join vorbereiten (labor_nr entspricht RNA-seq pid)
  dplyr::rename(pid = labor_nr, clinical_nr = nr) %>%

  # Validierung: pid muss existieren und eindeutig sein
  {
    if (!"pid" %in% names(.)) stop("Spalte 'labor_nr' fehlt — pid-mapping nicht möglich")
    if (any(is.na(.$pid))) stop("pid enthält NAs (n=", sum(is.na(.$pid)), ")")
    if (any(duplicated(.$pid))) stop("pid enthält Duplikate (n=", sum(duplicated(.$pid)), ")")
    message("✓ pid-validierung: ", length(unique(.$pid)), " eindeutige patienten-ids")
    .
  } %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # continuous versions (zusätzlich behalten; originale bleiben unverändert)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    gfr_cont = pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd,
    bmi_cont = bmi,
    euroscore_ii_percent = log_euroscore_ii,  # NOTE: nur umbenannt; siehe comment unten
    ef_cont = pr_echo_ef_percent,

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # gfr kategorien (kdigo 2012)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    gfr_impaired = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd) ~ NA_character_,
      pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd < 60 ~ "impaired",
      TRUE ~ "normal"
    ),
    gfr_cat = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd) ~ NA_character_,
      pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd < 30 ~ "severe",
      pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd < 60 ~ "moderate",
      TRUE ~ "normal"
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # bmi kategorien (who)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    bmi_obese = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(bmi) ~ NA_character_,
      bmi >= 30 ~ "obese",
      TRUE ~ "non_obese"
    ),
    bmi_cat = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(bmi) ~ NA_character_,
      bmi < 25 ~ "normal",
      bmi < 30 ~ "overweight",
      TRUE ~ "obese"
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # nyha gruppierung (3+4 zusammen wegen kleiner n)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    nyha_grouped = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(nyha_2) ~ NA_character_,
      nyha_2 >= 3 ~ "nyha_3_4",
      TRUE ~ "nyha_2"
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # euroscore kategorien (≥3% = high risk)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    euroscore_high = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(euroscore_ii_percent) ~ NA_character_,
      euroscore_ii_percent >= 3 ~ "high",
      TRUE ~ "low"
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # cardiometabolic burden (metabolic syndrome proxy)
    # NOTE: das ist NICHT atp-iii / ncep-mets, da waist/hdl/tg/glucose fehlen.
    # score 0–4: diabetes, dyslipidemia, hypertension, bmi≥30
    # missing wird als "no" behandelt, um score stabil zu halten.
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    metabolic_risk_score =
      (tidyr::replace_na(diabetes == "yes", FALSE)) +
      (tidyr::replace_na(dyslipedemia == "yes", FALSE)) +
      (tidyr::replace_na(hypertension == "yes", FALSE)) +
      (tidyr::replace_na(bmi >= 30, FALSE)),

    # binary flag nur für deskriptiv/tab1; analytisch bevorzugt score nutzen
    metabolic_risk_high = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(metabolic_risk_score) ~ NA_character_,
      metabolic_risk_score >= 2 ~ "yes",
      TRUE ~ "no"
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # yes/no zu logical konvertieren (für model covariates)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    dplyr::across(
      c(atrial_fibrillation_flutter, copd, diabetes, dyslipedemia, hypertension,
        p_avk, cerebrovascular_disease, significant_prior_cad, relevant_cad),
      ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x == "yes", FALSE)
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# faktorisierung (referenzlevel explizit gesetzt) + snake_case
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinical_clean <- clinical_clean %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pid = as.character(pid),

    # sex: ggf. input mapping nötig, falls "m/f" oder "male/female" gemischt ist
    sex = tolower(as.character(sex)),
    sex = dplyr::case_when(
      sex %in% c("m", "male", "männlich", "maennlich") ~ "male",
      sex %in% c("w", "f", "female", "weiblich") ~ "female",
      TRUE ~ sex
    ),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("male", "female")),

    ef_group = factor(ef_group, levels = c("preserved", "reduced")),
    valve_type_grouped = factor(valve_type_grouped, levels = c("bev", "sev")),

    gfr_impaired = factor(gfr_impaired, levels = c("normal", "impaired")),
    gfr_cat = factor(gfr_cat, levels = c("normal", "moderate", "severe")),

    bmi_obese = factor(bmi_obese, levels = c("non_obese", "obese")),
    bmi_cat = factor(bmi_cat, levels = c("normal", "overweight", "obese")),

    nyha_grouped = factor(nyha_grouped, levels = c("nyha_2", "nyha_3_4")),
    euroscore_high = factor(euroscore_high, levels = c("low", "high")),

    metabolic_risk_high = factor(metabolic_risk_high, levels = c("no", "yes"))
  )

message("✓ variables engineered: ", ncol(clinical_clean), " columns")
message("  new variables: gfr_cont, bmi_cont, euroscore_ii_percent, ef_cont, gfr_impaired, gfr_cat, bmi_obese, bmi_cat, nyha_grouped, euroscore_high, metabolic_risk_score, metabolic_risk_high")

```


```{r}
#| label: step2-comorbidity-correlation
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n=== SCHRITT 2.1: Comorbidity Correlation Matrix ===")

comorbidity_vars <- c(
  "diabetes",
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipedemia",
  "atrial_fibrillation_flutter",
  "copd",
  "significant_prior_cad"
)

available_comorbidities <- intersect(comorbidity_vars, names(clinical_clean))

if (length(available_comorbidities) >= 2) {

  comorbidity_data <- clinical_clean %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(available_comorbidities)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::everything(),
        ~ dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(.x) ~ NA_integer_,
          is.logical(.x) ~ as.integer(.x),
          is.numeric(.x) ~ as.integer(.x),
          is.factor(.x)  ~ as.integer(as.character(.x)),
          is.character(.x) ~ as.integer(.x %in% c("yes", "true", "1")),
          TRUE ~ NA_integer_
        )
      )
    )

  # drop constant columns (var == 0) to avoid NA correlations
  keep <- sapply(comorbidity_data, function(x) stats::var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
  if (sum(keep) < 2) {
    message("⚠️  Zu wenige variierende Komorbiditäten (Varianz=0) für Korrelationsmatrix.")
  } else {

    comorbidity_data <- comorbidity_data[, keep, drop = FALSE]

    comorbidity_cor_matrix <- stats::cor(comorbidity_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

    message("\n--- COMORBIDITY CORRELATION MATRIX (pearson on 0/1; ~phi) ---")
    print(round(comorbidity_cor_matrix, 2))

    # identify pairs in upper triangle only (avoid duplicates)
    upper_idx <- which(upper.tri(comorbidity_cor_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)

    cor_pairs <- tibble::tibble(
      var1 = rownames(comorbidity_cor_matrix)[upper_idx[, 1]],
      var2 = colnames(comorbidity_cor_matrix)[upper_idx[, 2]],
      r = comorbidity_cor_matrix[upper_idx]
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(r))

    high_pairs <- cor_pairs %>% dplyr::filter(abs(r) >= 0.7)
    moderate_pairs <- cor_pairs %>% dplyr::filter(abs(r) > 0.5, abs(r) < 0.7)

    if (nrow(high_pairs) > 0) {
      message("\n⚠️  Hohe Korrelationen gefunden (|r| ≥ 0.7):")
      apply(high_pairs, 1, function(row) {
        message(sprintf("  %s ↔ %s: r = %.2f (VIF-Monitoring erforderlich)", row["var1"], row["var2"], as.numeric(row["r"])))
      })
    }

    if (nrow(moderate_pairs) > 0) {
      message("\n⚠️  Moderate Korrelationen gefunden (0.5 < |r| < 0.7):")
      apply(moderate_pairs, 1, function(row) {
        message(sprintf("  %s ↔ %s: r = %.2f", row["var1"], row["var2"], as.numeric(row["r"])))
      })
    }

    if (nrow(high_pairs) == 0 && nrow(moderate_pairs) == 0) {
      message("\n✓ Keine problematischen Korrelationen (alle |r| ≤ 0.5)")
    }

    readr::write_csv(
      as.data.frame(comorbidity_cor_matrix),
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "comorbidity_correlation_matrix.csv")
    )
    message("\n💾 Korrelationsmatrix gespeichert: comorbidity_correlation_matrix.csv")

    # heatmap
    tryCatch({
      pdf(file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "comorbidity_correlation_heatmap.pdf"),
          width = 8, height = 7)
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        comorbidity_cor_matrix,
        display_numbers = TRUE,
        number_format = "%.2f",
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_cols = TRUE,
        main = "Comorbidity Correlation Matrix"
      )
      invisible(dev.off())
      message("📊 Heatmap erstellt: comorbidity_correlation_heatmap.pdf")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("⚠️  Heatmap konnte nicht erstellt werden: ", conditionMessage(e))
    })
  }

} else {
  message("⚠️  Zu wenige Komorbidität-Variablen verfügbar für Korrelationsmatrix")
}

```

# SCHRITT 3: Join Clinical → RNA-seq Metadata

**Ziel:** Klinische Daten mit clinical_sample_meta verknüpfen, vollständige QC

**Kritische Checks:**
- Patienten-ID-Matching (Nr ↔ pid)
- Join-Rate dokumentieren

```{r}
#| label: step3-join-metadata
#| echo: false
#| warning: true

message("=== SCHRITT 3: Join Clinical → RNA-seq Metadata ===")

# ============================================================
# RNA-seq Metadata laden (aus DEanalysis.qmd Cache)
# ============================================================

# WICHTIG: Dieser Chunk setzt voraus, dass DEanalysis.qmd bereits
# gelaufen ist und clinical_sample_meta als RDS gespeichert hat.
# Falls nicht: Erst DEanalysis.qmd bis zur Meta-Erstellung laufen lassen.

deanalysis_cache <- "../../../res/cache/sample_meta_deseq2.rds"

if (!file.exists(deanalysis_cache)) {
  stop(
    "❌ clinical_sample_meta nicht gefunden. Bitte erst DEanalysis.qmd bis Chunk 'deseq2-normalization' laufen lassen.",
    "\n   Erwarteter Pfad: ", deanalysis_cache
  )
}

clinical_sample_meta <- readRDS(deanalysis_cache)
message("✓ Geladen: clinical_sample_meta (n=", nrow(clinical_sample_meta), " samples)")

# === PRE-JOIN DIAGNOSTIK ===
# Dokumentation der pid-Überlappung zwischen Clinical und RNA-seq.
# Zweck: Frühzeitige Erkennung von Mapping-Fehlern.
#
#
# Join-Strategie:
#   - left_join auf clinical_sample_meta (behält alle RNA-seq Samples)
#   - Clinical-Daten werden als NAs eingefügt für unmatched RNA-seq
#   - Alternative wäre inner_join (nur matched), aber dann verlieren wir Samples

# Unique PIDs in beiden Datasets
pids_clinical <- unique(clinical_clean$pid)
pids_rnaseq <- unique(clinical_sample_meta$pid)

n_clinical <- length(pids_clinical)
n_rnaseq <- length(pids_rnaseq)

# Matching-Statistik
pids_both <- intersect(pids_clinical, pids_rnaseq)
pids_clinical_only <- setdiff(pids_clinical, pids_rnaseq)
pids_rnaseq_only <- setdiff(pids_rnaseq, pids_clinical)

message("\n--- PRE-JOIN DIAGNOSTIK ---")
message("Clinical patients: ", n_clinical)
message("RNA-seq patients: ", n_rnaseq)
message("Matched: ", length(pids_both), " (",
        round(length(pids_both)/n_rnaseq*100, 1), "% of RNA-seq)")
message("Clinical-only: ", length(pids_clinical_only))
message("RNA-seq-only: ", length(pids_rnaseq_only))

if (length(pids_clinical_only) > 0) {
  message("→ Unmatched Clinical PIDs: ", paste(pids_clinical_only, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(pids_rnaseq_only) > 0) {
  message("→ Unmatched RNA-seq PIDs: ", paste(pids_rnaseq_only, collapse = ", "))
}

# ============================================================
# JOIN (left_join auf clinical_sample_meta)
# ============================================================

sample_meta_clinical <- clinical_sample_meta %>%
  left_join(clinical_clean, by = "pid", suffix = c("_rnaseq", "_clinical"))

# Validierung: Row count muss identisch sein (kein Expansion)
stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta_clinical) == nrow(clinical_sample_meta))

# ============================================================
# POST-JOIN VALIDIERUNG
# ============================================================

# Join-Indikator: hat dieser RNA-seq PID irgendeinen Clinical-Match?
sample_meta_clinical <- clinical_sample_meta %>%
  left_join(clinical_clean %>% dplyr::mutate(has_clinical = TRUE),
            by = "pid", suffix = c("_rnaseq", "_clinical")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(has_clinical = dplyr::if_else(is.na(has_clinical), FALSE, has_clinical))

stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta_clinical) == nrow(clinical_sample_meta))

n_mapped  <- sum(sample_meta_clinical$has_clinical)
join_rate <- n_mapped / nrow(sample_meta_clinical)

message("\n--- POST-JOIN DIAGNOSTIK ---")
message("Total samples: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical))
message("Mapped samples: ", n_mapped, " (", round(join_rate*100, 1), "%)")
message("Unmapped samples: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical) - n_mapped)

# CRITICAL CHECK: Join-Rate sollte >90% sein
if (join_rate < 0.9) {
  warning("⚠️ Join-Rate < 90% — prüfe Patienten-ID-Kodierung!")
}

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================

saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical.rds"))
message("💾 Gespeichert: sample_meta_clinical.rds")
```

# SCHRITT 4: Dropout-Analyse

**Ziel:** Dokumentiere n pro Zeitpunkt, teste MCAR-Annahme

**Stop-Regel:** Wenn >30% Dropout → Analysestrategie reassessieren

```{r}
#| label: step4-dropout-analysis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 4: Dropout-Analyse ===")

# ============================================================
# N pro Zeitpunkt
# ============================================================

n_per_timepoint <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_with_clinical = sum(!is.na(age)),
    pct_clinical = round(n_with_clinical / n_total * 100, 1)
  )

print(n_per_timepoint)

# === DROPOUT-ANALYSE ===
# Dokumentation fehlender Zeitpunkte (Triplet-Completeness).
#
# Rationale:
#   - Paired/Longitudinal Designs erfordern vollständige Messungen (A, V1, V2)
#   - Dropout (fehlende Zeitpunkte) kann Bias erzeugen, falls nicht MCAR
#   - Mixed models tolerieren unbalanced data, aber complete-case bevorzugt für Paired Tests
#
# Dropout-Mechanismen:
#   - MCAR (Missing Completely At Random): Dropout unabhängig von Baseline oder Outcomes
#   - MAR (Missing At Random): Dropout abhängig von beobachteten Baseline-Variablen
#   - MNAR (Missing Not At Random): Dropout abhängig von nicht-beobachteten Outcomes
#
# Test-Strategie:
#   - Logistic Regression: dropout ~ Baseline-Charakteristika
#   - Falls p < 0.05 → MAR/MNAR → Complete-case biased
#   - Falls p ≥ 0.05 → konsistent mit MCAR → Complete-case vertretbar
#
# Stop-Regel:
#   - Dropout > 30% → Analysestrategie anpassen (mixed models statt complete-case)

triplet_status <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  group_by(pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_timepoints = n(),
    has_A = any(timepoint == "A"),
    has_V1 = any(timepoint == "V1"),
    has_V2 = any(timepoint == "V2"),
    complete_triplet = n_timepoints == 3 & has_A & has_V1 & has_V2
  )

n_complete <- sum(triplet_status$complete_triplet)
n_total_patients <- nrow(triplet_status)
dropout_rate <- 1 - (n_complete / n_total_patients)

message("\n--- TRIPLET COMPLETENESS ---")
message("Total patients: ", n_total_patients)
message("Complete triplets (A + V1 + V2): ", n_complete)
message("Dropout rate: ", round(dropout_rate * 100, 1), "%")

message("ℹ️ Hinweis: LMMs (Likelihood-basiert) sind Standard-of-Care für unbalanced longitudinale Daten und liefern unter MCAR/MAR valide Schätzer. Complete-case wird hier v.a. für Sensitivity/paired Analysen definiert.")


# STOP-REGEL: >30% Dropout
if (dropout_rate > 0.3) {
  warning(
    "⚠️ STOP-REGEL AUSGELÖST: Dropout rate > 30%!\n",
    "   → Analysestrategie muss angepasst werden (mixed models statt complete-case)\n",
    "   → Oder: Dropout-Charakteristika analysieren (MCAR vs MAR?)"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Dropout-Charakteristika (falls Dropout > 10%)
# ============================================================

if (dropout_rate > 0.1) {
  message("\n--- DROPOUT CHARACTERISTICS ---")

  dropout_comparison <- clinical_clean %>%
    mutate(
      dropout = !(pid %in% triplet_status$pid[triplet_status$complete_triplet])
    ) %>%
    group_by(dropout) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
      bmi_mean = mean(bmi, na.rm = TRUE),
      diabetes_rate = mean(diabetes, na.rm = TRUE),
      hypertension_rate = mean(hypertension, na.rm = TRUE),
      euroscore_mean = mean(log_euroscore_ii, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_female = mean(sex == "female", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      pct_reduced_EF = mean(ef_group == "reduced", na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    )

  print(dropout_comparison)

  # ============================================================
  # Test auf MCAR: Logistic Regression Approach
  # ============================================================
  # Frage: Können Baseline-Charakteristika Dropout vorhersagen?
  # Falls ja → MAR oder MNAR (nicht MCAR)

  message("\n--- MCAR TEST (Logistic Regression) ---")

  # Erstelle Dropout-Indikator (0 = complete, 1 = dropout)
  clinical_mcar_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(sex)) %>%
    left_join(
      triplet_status %>% dplyr::select(pid, complete_triplet),
      by = "pid"
    ) %>%
    mutate(dropout = ifelse(complete_triplet, 0, 1)) %>%
    filter(timepoint == "A") %>%  # Nur Baseline für Test
    dplyr::select(dropout, age, sex, log_euroscore_ii, ef_group) %>%
    filter(!is.na(log_euroscore_ii), !is.na(ef_group))

  if (nrow(clinical_mcar_data) > 30 && sum(clinical_mcar_data$dropout) >= 10) {
    tryCatch({
      clinical_mcar_model <- glm(
        dropout ~ age + sex + log_euroscore_ii + ef_group,
        data = clinical_mcar_data,
        family = binomial(link = "logit")
      )

      clinical_mcar_anova <- anova(clinical_mcar_model, test = "Chisq")

      # Sicheres Extrahieren: nur wenn mehr als Intercept-Zeile
      if (nrow(clinical_mcar_anova) > 1) {
        clinical_mcar_pval <- min(clinical_mcar_anova$`Pr(>Chi)`[-1], na.rm = TRUE)

        message("  Modell: dropout ~ age + sex + euroscore + ef_group")
        message("  Minimum p-value: ", format.pval(clinical_mcar_pval, digits = 3))

        # Zeige auch Koeffizienten (Effektstärken)
        clinical_mcar_summary <- summary(clinical_mcar_model)
        message("\n  Prädiktoren mit p < 0.10:")
        coef_tbl <- as.data.frame(clinical_mcar_summary$coefficients)
        coef_tbl$predictor <- rownames(coef_tbl)
        sig_predictors <- coef_tbl[coef_tbl$`Pr(>|z|)` < 0.10 & coef_tbl$predictor != "(Intercept)", ]
        if (nrow(sig_predictors) > 0) {
          for (i in 1:nrow(sig_predictors)) {
            message(sprintf("    %s: OR = %.2f, p = %.3f",
                            sig_predictors$predictor[i],
                            exp(sig_predictors$Estimate[i]),
                            sig_predictors$`Pr(>|z|)`[i]))
          }
        }

        if (clinical_mcar_pval < 0.05) {
          message("\n  → WARNUNG: Dropout assoziiert mit Baseline-Charakteristika (p < 0.05)")
          message("     Missingness ist MAR oder MNAR, NICHT MCAR")
          message("     → Complete-case Analyse könnte biased sein")
          message("     → Alternative: Mixed models (tolerieren unbalanced data)")
        } else {
          message("\n  → Dropout NICHT signifikant assoziiert mit Baseline (p ≥ 0.05)")
          message("     Konsistent mit MCAR-Annahme")
          message("     → Complete-case Analyse vertretbar (aber mixed models bevorzugt)")
        }
      } else {
        message("  ⚠️ MCAR-Modell hat keine Prädiktoren (nur Intercept)")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("  ⚠️ MCAR-Test fehlgeschlagen: ", conditionMessage(e))
      message("     → Prüfe Dropout-Charakteristika visuell via dropout_comparison")
    })
  } else {
    message("  ⚠️ Zu wenige Dropouts für MCAR-Test (n=", sum(clinical_mcar_data$dropout),
            ", min. 10 erforderlich)")
    message("     → Visuell prüfen via dropout_comparison")
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Complete-Case Dataset für Primary Analyses
# ============================================================

sample_meta_clinical_complete <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(pid %in% triplet_status$pid[triplet_status$complete_triplet]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(age))  # Alle mit klinischen Daten

message("\n✓ Complete-case dataset: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical_complete),
        " samples from ", n_distinct(sample_meta_clinical_complete$pid), " patients")

saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical_complete,
        file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical_complete.rds"))

```


---

# SCHRITT 5: Cell-type Deconvolution (Dual-Method Validation)

**Ziel:** Robuste Zelltyp-Proportionen-Schätzung mit Cross-Validation

**Methoden:**
1. **CIBERSORT mit LM22** (primär, fraction-based)
2. **MCP-counter** (Validierung, enrichment-based)

**Literatur-Basis:**
- Newman et al. 2015 (Nat Methods): CIBERSORT/LM22 Gold-Standard für Blut
- Avila Cobos et al. 2020 (Nat Commun): Dual-method Validation empfohlen


```{r}
#| label: step5-deconvolution
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 5: Cell-type Deconvolution (Dual-Method) ===")

# === METHODOLOGIE (Literatur-basiert) ===
#
# Strategie: Dual-Method Validation (CIBERSORT + MCP-counter)
# Literatur:
#   - Avila Cobos et al. 2020 (Nat Commun): "Benchmarking of deconvolution pipelines"
#   - Nadel et al. 2021 (Brief Bioinform): "Thousands of clinical samples"
#   - Sturm et al. 2020 (Methods Mol Biol): "immunedeconv package"
#
# Rationale für Dual-Method:
#   - Einzelne Methode kann method-specific bias haben
#   - Cross-Validation erhöht Robustheit
#
# === METHODE 1: CIBERSORT (primär, fraction-based) ===
# Literatur: Newman et al. 2015, Nat Methods
#
# === METHODE 2: MCP-counter (Validierung, enrichment-based) ===
# Literatur: Becht et al. 2016, Genome Biol
#
# → VST-Daten sind UNGEEIGNET (variance-stabilized, log-scale)
# → Lade DESeq2 raw counts, normalisiere zu CPM

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_deconv_cache_cibersort <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "deconvolution_cibersort.rds")
clinical_deconv_cache_mcp <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "deconvolution_mcp_validation.rds")
clinical_deconv_cache_combined <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "deconvolution_combined.rds")

# === CELL-TYPE DECONVOLUTION: DUAL-METHOD VALIDATION ===

immunedeconv::set_cibersort_binary("../../../dat/CIBERSORT.R")
immunedeconv::set_cibersort_mat("../../../dat/LM22.txt")

# === CACHE-HANDLING ===
if (file.exists(clinical_deconv_cache_combined)) {
  message("✅ Lade Combined Deconvolution Cache")
  clinical_deconv_combined <- readRDS(clinical_deconv_cache_combined)

} else {
  message("⏳ Führe Dual-Method Deconvolution durch...")

  # ============================================================
  # STEP 1: Lade RAW COUNTS
  # ============================================================
  # Literatur: Avila Cobos 2020 - "Linear scale counts or CPM, NOT TPM/log"

  # Lade DESeq2-Objekt (enthält raw counts)
  deanalysis_dds_cache <- "../../../res/cache/dds_DESeq_fitted.rds"

  if (!file.exists(deanalysis_dds_cache)) {
    stop(
      "❌ DESeq2-Objekt nicht gefunden.",
      "\n   Erwarteter Pfad: ", deanalysis_dds_cache,
      "\n   Bitte erst DEanalysis.qmd bis 'deseq2-normalization' laufen lassen."
    )
  }

  clinical_dds <- readRDS(deanalysis_dds_cache)
  clinical_raw_counts <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(clinical_dds, "counts")
  message("✓ Raw counts geladen: ", nrow(clinical_raw_counts), " genes × ",
          ncol(clinical_raw_counts), " samples")

  # ============================================================
  # STEP 2: CPM-Normalisierung (counts per million)
  # ============================================================
  # Literatur: Monaco et al. 2019 - "mRNA abundance normalization"

  clinical_library_sizes <- colSums(clinical_raw_counts)
  clinical_cpm_matrix <- sweep(clinical_raw_counts, 2, clinical_library_sizes / 1e6, "/")

  message("✓ CPM-Normalisierung abgeschlossen")
  message("  Library sizes: ", paste(round(range(clinical_library_sizes) / 1e6, 2), collapse = "–"), " Mio reads")

  # ============================================================
  # STEP 3: ENSEMBL → Gene Symbol Konvertierung
  # ============================================================
  # Gleiche Logik wie bei quanTIseq, aber mit CPM statt VST

  if (all(grepl("^ENSG", rownames(clinical_cpm_matrix)[1:10]))) {
    message("→ Matrix hat ENSEMBL-IDs, konvertiere zu Gene-Symbolen...")

    clinical_cpm_ensembl <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(clinical_cpm_matrix))

    clinical_ensembl_to_symbol <- suppressMessages(
      AnnotationDbi::select(
        org.Hs.eg.db,
        keys = clinical_cpm_ensembl,
        columns = "SYMBOL",
        keytype = "ENSEMBL"
      )
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(ENSEMBL, SYMBOL) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

    message("  Mapped ", nrow(clinical_ensembl_to_symbol), " / ",
            length(clinical_cpm_ensembl), " ENSEMBL IDs to symbols")

    # Filtere Matrix auf mappbare Gene
    clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols <- clinical_cpm_matrix[
  clinical_cpm_ensembl %in% clinical_ensembl_to_symbol$ENSEMBL, , drop = FALSE
]

    rownames(clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols) <- clinical_ensembl_to_symbol$SYMBOL[
      match(clinical_cpm_ensembl[clinical_cpm_ensembl %in% clinical_ensembl_to_symbol$ENSEMBL],
            clinical_ensembl_to_symbol$ENSEMBL)
    ]

    # Duplikate: Mittelwert (robust)
    if (any(duplicated(rownames(clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols)))) {
      message("  → ", sum(duplicated(rownames(clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols))),
              " duplizierte Gene-Symbole, berechne Mittelwerte...")

      clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols <- as.data.frame(clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), mean)) %>%
        tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
        as.matrix()
    }

    message("✓ Konvertierung: ", nrow(clinical_cpm_matrix), " → ",
            nrow(clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols), " genes mit Symbolen")

    # Validierung: Mindest-Gene
    if (nrow(clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols) < 5000) {
      warning("⚠️ Nur ", nrow(clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols), " Gene mit Symbolen")
      warning("   CIBERSORT/MCP-counter empfehlen ≥8000 Gene für robuste Schätzung")
    }

    clinical_cpm_matrix <- clinical_cpm_matrix_symbols
  }

  # ============================================================
  # STEP 4a: CIBERSORT (primär, fraction-based)
  # ============================================================
  # Literatur: Newman et al. 2015, Nat Methods

  message("\n⏳Running CIBERSORT with LM22 signature")
  message("   Method: fraction-based, 22 cell types")
  message("   Reference: LM22 (547 genes, whole blood validated)")

  clinical_deconv_cibersort <- tryCatch({
    immunedeconv::deconvolute(
      gene_expression = clinical_cpm_matrix,
      method = "cibersort",
      tumor = FALSE,
      arrays = FALSE # RNA-seq (not microarray)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("❌ cibersort failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    message("   Falls Token erforderlich: set_cibersort_binary() / set_cibersort_mat()")
    return(NULL)
  })

  if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_cibersort)) {
    message("✓ cibersort completed: ", nrow(clinical_deconv_cibersort),
            " cell types × ", ncol(clinical_deconv_cibersort) - 1, " samples")

    # Format: Long → Wide (samples × cell types)
    clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide <- clinical_deconv_cibersort %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = -cell_type,
        names_to = "sample_id",
        values_to = "fraction"
      ) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = cell_type,
        values_from = fraction,
        names_prefix = "CIBERSORT_"
      )

    # Bereinige Namen
    colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide))
    colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide) <- gsub("\\(", "", colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide))
    colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide) <- gsub("\\)", "", colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide))
    colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide) <- gsub("\\+", "plus", colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide))
    colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide))

    saveRDS(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide, clinical_deconv_cache_cibersort)
    message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_deconv_cache_cibersort)

  } else {
    message("⚠️ cibersort nicht verfügbar")
    clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide <- NULL
  }

  # ============================================================
  # STEP 4b: MCP-counter (Validierung, enrichment-based)
  # ============================================================
  # Literatur: Becht et al. 2016, Genome Biol
  # WICHTIG: Scores sind NICHT Fraktionen!

  message("\n⏳ Running MCP-counter for validation...")
  message("   Method: enrichment-based (dimensionless scores)")
  message("   Note: developed/validated mainly for tissue microenvironment; use in
          blood is a limitation")

  clinical_deconv_mcp <- tryCatch({
    immunedeconv::deconvolute(
      gene_expression = clinical_cpm_matrix,
      method = "mcp_counter"
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("❌ MCP-counter failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    return(NULL)
  })

  if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_mcp)) {
    message("✓ MCP-counter completed: ", nrow(clinical_deconv_mcp),
            " cell types × ", ncol(clinical_deconv_mcp) - 1, " samples")

    # Format: Long → Wide
    clinical_deconv_mcp_wide <- clinical_deconv_mcp %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = -cell_type,
        names_to = "sample_id",
        values_to = "enrichment_score"
      ) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = cell_type,
        values_from = enrichment_score,
        names_prefix = "MCP_"
      )

    # Bereinige Namen
    colnames(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide))
    colnames(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide) <- gsub("\\+", "plus", colnames(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide))

    saveRDS(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide, clinical_deconv_cache_mcp)
    message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_deconv_cache_mcp)

  } else {
    message("⚠️ MCP-counter nicht verfügbar")
    clinical_deconv_mcp_wide <- NULL
  }

  # ============================================================
  # STEP 5: Cross-Method Validation (Extended)
  # ============================================================
  #
  # === LITERATURE CONTEXT (Updated) ===
  #
  # Key insight: There is NO universal correlation cutoff for cross-method
  # validation. Correlation magnitudes are highly cell-type and dataset-dependent.
  #
  # References:
  #   - Newman et al. 2015 (CIBERSORT): Validation against flow cytometry,
  #     correlations vary by cell type (r = 0.3-0.9 depending on cell population)
  #   - Avila Cobos et al. 2020 (Nat Commun): "Benchmarking of deconvolution pipelines"
  #     → Input scale/preprocessing affects results substantially
  #     → Evaluation via multiple metrics recommended
  #   - Sturm et al. 2019 (Bioinformatics): immunedeconv benchmarking shows
  #     method-specific biases, no ground truth in most clinical samples
  #
  # Best practice (our approach):
  #   1. Use MULTIPLE metrics (Pearson r, Spearman rho) not single cutoffs
  #   2. Visualize agreement via scatterplots (pattern recognition > thresholds)
  #   3. Assess longitudinal consistency via patient-level deltas
  #   4. Report as "screening/QC" rather than "pass/fail"
  #   5. Use sensitivity analysis instead of binary inclusion/exclusion decisions
  #
  # IMPORTANT: CIBERSORT produces FRACTIONS (sum to 1, compositional constraint)
  # while MCP-counter produces ENRICHMENT SCORES (unbounded, not fractions).
  # Direct comparison is inherently imperfect; we assess RELATIVE agreement.
  # ============================================================

  if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide) && !is.null(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide)) {
    message("\n=== CROSS-METHOD VALIDATION (Extended QC Panel) ===")
    message("Note: Comparing CIBERSORT fractions vs MCP-counter scores")
    message("      No universal cutoffs; this is screening/QC, not pass/fail")

    # Merge both datasets
    clinical_deconv_merged <- clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide %>%
      dplyr::left_join(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide, by = "sample_id")

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # C1: Cross-Method Mapping mit flexibler Spaltenerkennung
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Biologisch sinnvolle Aggregation vor dem Matching:
    # - NK: Summe aus resting + activated
    # - B: Summe aller B-Zell-Subtypen
    # - T: Summe aller T-Zell-Subtypen
    # - Monocytes/Neutrophils: direkt (keine Subtypen in LM22)
    #
    # MCP-counter Spaltennamen variieren je nach Version/Einstellung,
    # daher flexible Pattern-Suche statt exakter Namen.

    # Verfuegbare Spalten identifizieren
    cib_cols <- names(clinical_deconv_merged)[grepl("^CIBERSORT_", names(clinical_deconv_merged))]
    mcp_cols <- names(clinical_deconv_merged)[grepl("^MCP_", names(clinical_deconv_merged))]

    message("\n--- Verfuegbare Zelltypen ---")
    message("  CIBERSORT (", length(cib_cols), "): ",
            paste(gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", cib_cols), collapse = ", "))
    message("  MCP-counter (", length(mcp_cols), "): ",
            paste(gsub("MCP_", "", mcp_cols), collapse = ", "))

    # Hilfsfunktion: Finde beste passende Spalte via Pattern
    find_col <- function(cols, patterns, ignore_case = TRUE) {
      for (pat in patterns) {
        matches <- grep(pat, cols, value = TRUE, ignore.case = ignore_case)
        if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1])
      }
      return(NA_character_)
    }

    # ============================================================
    # CIBERSORT Aggregate erstellen (biologisch korrekt)
    # ============================================================
    #
    # WICHTIG: Praezise Patterns verwenden um falsche Zuordnungen zu vermeiden!
    # Problem: "T_cell" Pattern koennte auch "Mast_cell" matchen wenn nicht sauber.
    # Loesung: Anchor-Patterns mit "^CIBERSORT_" Prefix fuer eindeutiges Matching.
    #
    # LM22 Zelltypen (nach Sanitization):
    # - T_cells_*: CD8, CD4_naive, CD4_memory_resting, CD4_memory_activated,
    #              follicular_helper, regulatory_Tregs, gamma_delta
    # - B_cells_*: naive, memory
    # - NK_cells_*: resting, activated
    # - Mast_cells_*: resting, activated (NICHT zu T-Zellen!)
    # - Monocytes, Neutrophils: direkt (keine Subtypen)

    message("\n--- Erstelle CIBERSORT Aggregate ---")

    # Hilfsfunktion: Sichere Aggregation mit explizitem Logging
    safe_aggregate <- function(df, cols, new_col_name) {
      if (length(cols) == 0) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }
      rowSums(df[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # T-Zellen: NUR echte T_cells_* Spalten (NICHT Mast_cells!)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Pattern: Beginnt mit "CIBERSORT_T_cells_" (nach Sanitization)
    tcell_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_T_cells_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)

    # Fallback: Auch "T_cell_" ohne 's' pruefen (je nach Sanitization)
    if (length(tcell_cib_cols) == 0) {
      tcell_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_T_cell_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)
    }

    # Sicherheitscheck: Mast_cells duerfen NICHT enthalten sein!
    tcell_cib_cols <- tcell_cib_cols[!grepl("Mast", tcell_cib_cols, ignore.case = TRUE)]

    if (length(tcell_cib_cols) > 0) {
      clinical_deconv_merged$CIBERSORT_t_cell_total <- safe_aggregate(
        clinical_deconv_merged, tcell_cib_cols, "t_cell_total"
      )
      message("  t_cell_total: Summe aus ", length(tcell_cib_cols), " Subtypen")
      message("    -> ", paste(gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", tcell_cib_cols), collapse = ", "))
    } else {
      clinical_deconv_merged$CIBERSORT_t_cell_total <- NA_real_
      message("  WARNUNG: Keine T-Zell-Spalten gefunden")
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # B-Zellen: NUR B_cells_* Spalten
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    bcell_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_B_cells_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)
    if (length(bcell_cib_cols) == 0) {
      bcell_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_B_cell_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)
    }

    if (length(bcell_cib_cols) > 0) {
      clinical_deconv_merged$CIBERSORT_b_cell_total <- safe_aggregate(
        clinical_deconv_merged, bcell_cib_cols, "b_cell_total"
      )
      message("  b_cell_total: Summe aus ", length(bcell_cib_cols), " Subtypen")
      message("    -> ", paste(gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", bcell_cib_cols), collapse = ", "))
    } else {
      clinical_deconv_merged$CIBERSORT_b_cell_total <- NA_real_
      message("  WARNUNG: Keine B-Zell-Spalten gefunden")
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # NK-Zellen: NUR NK_cells_* Spalten
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    nk_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_NK_cells_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)
    if (length(nk_cib_cols) == 0) {
      nk_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_NK_cell_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)
    }

    if (length(nk_cib_cols) > 0) {
      clinical_deconv_merged$CIBERSORT_nk_cell_total <- safe_aggregate(
        clinical_deconv_merged, nk_cib_cols, "nk_cell_total"
      )
      message("  nk_cell_total: Summe aus ", length(nk_cib_cols), " Subtypen")
      message("    -> ", paste(gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", nk_cib_cols), collapse = ", "))
    } else {
      clinical_deconv_merged$CIBERSORT_nk_cell_total <- NA_real_
      message("  WARNUNG: Keine NK-Zell-Spalten gefunden")
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Mastzellen: Separat aggregieren (NEU - nicht mit T-Zellen mischen!)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    mast_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_Mast_cells_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)
    if (length(mast_cib_cols) == 0) {
      mast_cib_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_Mast_cell_", cib_cols, value = TRUE)
    }

    if (length(mast_cib_cols) > 0) {
      clinical_deconv_merged$CIBERSORT_mast_cell_total <- safe_aggregate(
        clinical_deconv_merged, mast_cib_cols, "mast_cell_total"
      )
      message("  mast_cell_total: Summe aus ", length(mast_cib_cols), " Subtypen")
      message("    -> ", paste(gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", mast_cib_cols), collapse = ", "))
    } else {
      message("  mast_cell_total: Keine Mast-Zell-Spalten gefunden (optional)")
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Monozyten: direkt (keine Subtypen in LM22)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    mono_cib_col <- find_col(cib_cols, c("^CIBERSORT_Monocytes$", "^CIBERSORT_Monocyte$"))
    if (!is.na(mono_cib_col)) {
      message("  monocyte: ", gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", mono_cib_col), " (direkt)")
    } else {
      message("  WARNUNG: Keine Monozyten-Spalte gefunden")
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Neutrophile: direkt
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    neutro_cib_col <- find_col(cib_cols, c("^CIBERSORT_Neutrophils$", "^CIBERSORT_Neutrophil$"))
    if (!is.na(neutro_cib_col)) {
      message("  neutrophil: ", gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", neutro_cib_col), " (direkt)")
    } else {
      message("  WARNUNG: Keine Neutrophilen-Spalte gefunden")
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validierung: Zusammenfassung der Aggregate
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    message("\n--- Aggregat-Validierung ---")
    n_tcell <- length(tcell_cib_cols)
    n_bcell <- length(bcell_cib_cols)
    n_nk <- length(nk_cib_cols)
    n_mast <- length(mast_cib_cols)
    message("  T-Zellen: ", n_tcell, " Subtypen (erwartet: 7 in LM22)")
    message("  B-Zellen: ", n_bcell, " Subtypen (erwartet: 2 in LM22)")
    message("  NK-Zellen: ", n_nk, " Subtypen (erwartet: 2 in LM22)")
    message("  Mast-Zellen: ", n_mast, " Subtypen (erwartet: 2 in LM22, separat!)")

    # ============================================================
    # MCP-counter Spalten finden (flexible Patterns)
    # ============================================================

    message("\n--- Suche MCP-counter Entsprechungen ---")

    # MCP T-Zellen
    mcp_tcell_col <- find_col(mcp_cols, c("^MCP_T_cell", "^MCP_T.cell", "^MCP_Tcell"))
    if (!is.na(mcp_tcell_col)) message("  T cells: ", mcp_tcell_col)

    # MCP B-Zellen (oft "B lineage" oder "B_lineage")
    mcp_bcell_col <- find_col(mcp_cols, c("B_lineage", "B.lineage", "B_cell", "Blineage"))
    if (!is.na(mcp_bcell_col)) message("  B cells: ", mcp_bcell_col)

    # MCP NK-Zellen
    mcp_nk_col <- find_col(mcp_cols, c("NK_cell", "NK.cell", "NKcell"))
    if (!is.na(mcp_nk_col)) message("  NK cells: ", mcp_nk_col)

    # MCP Monozyten (oft "Monocytic lineage")
    mcp_mono_col <- find_col(mcp_cols, c("Monocyt", "monocyt", "Monocitic"))
    if (!is.na(mcp_mono_col)) message("  Monocytes: ", mcp_mono_col)

    # MCP Neutrophile
    mcp_neutro_col <- find_col(mcp_cols, c("Neutrophil", "neutrophil"))
    if (!is.na(mcp_neutro_col)) message("  Neutrophils: ", mcp_neutro_col)

    # ============================================================
    # Mapping-Tabelle dynamisch erstellen
    # ============================================================
    # Verwendet die neuen snake_case Aggregate-Spaltennamen

    # Aktualisierte Spaltenliste nach Aggregat-Erstellung
    all_cols <- names(clinical_deconv_merged)

    # Mapping-Paare definieren (nur wenn beide Seiten existieren)
    # snake_case fuer neue Aggregate: t_cell_total, b_cell_total, etc.
    mapping_candidates <- list(
      list(
        pair_name = "t_cells",
        cib_col = if ("CIBERSORT_t_cell_total" %in% all_cols) "CIBERSORT_t_cell_total" else NA,
        mcp_col = mcp_tcell_col
      ),
      list(
        pair_name = "b_cells",
        cib_col = if ("CIBERSORT_b_cell_total" %in% all_cols) "CIBERSORT_b_cell_total" else NA,
        mcp_col = mcp_bcell_col
      ),
      list(
        pair_name = "nk_cells",
        cib_col = if ("CIBERSORT_nk_cell_total" %in% all_cols) "CIBERSORT_nk_cell_total" else NA,
        mcp_col = mcp_nk_col
      ),
      list(
        pair_name = "monocytes",
        cib_col = mono_cib_col,
        mcp_col = mcp_mono_col
      ),
      list(
        pair_name = "neutrophils",
        cib_col = neutro_cib_col,
        mcp_col = mcp_neutro_col
      )
    )

    # Nur gueltige Paare behalten (beide Spalten muessen existieren)
    valid_mappings <- lapply(mapping_candidates, function(m) {
      if (!is.na(m$cib_col) && !is.na(m$mcp_col) &&
          m$cib_col %in% all_cols && m$mcp_col %in% all_cols) {
        return(tibble::tibble(
          pair_name = m$pair_name,
          cibersort_col = m$cib_col,
          mcp_col = m$mcp_col
        ))
      }
      return(NULL)
    })

    cross_method_mapping <- dplyr::bind_rows(valid_mappings[!sapply(valid_mappings, is.null)])

    # Ausgabe mit Erwartung fuer Vollblut
    n_pairs <- nrow(cross_method_mapping)
    message("\n--- Cross-method pairs available: ", n_pairs, " (erwartet >=4 fuer Vollblut) ---")

    if (n_pairs < 4) {
      message("  WARNUNG: Weniger als 4 Paare gefunden!")
      message("  Moegliche Ursachen:")
      message("    - Unerwartete Spaltennamen nach Sanitization")
      message("    - MCP-counter Version mit anderen Zelltyp-Namen")
      message("  Debug: Pruefe Spaltennamen oben")
    }

    if (n_pairs > 0) {
      for (i in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
        message("  ", cross_method_mapping$pair_name[i], ": ",
                cross_method_mapping$cibersort_col[i], " <-> ",
                cross_method_mapping$mcp_col[i])
      }
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # C2: Holistic QC Panel (Multi-Metric Table)
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # WICHTIG: MCP-counter liefert Enrichment-Scores, CIBERSORT liefert Fraktionen.
    # Diese sind nicht direkt vergleichbar -> Spearman (Rang-basiert) ist primaer!
    # Delta-QC (within-patient changes) reduziert zusaetzlich kompositionelle Artefakte.
    #
    # Metriken (Prioritaet):
    #   1. spearman_rho - primaer (Rang-Agreement, skalenunabhaengig)
    #   2. pearson_r    - sekundaer (lineares Agreement, sensitiv auf Skala)
    #   3. delta_qc     - wichtig fuer longitudinale Konsistenz
    #
    # KEINE harten Cutoffs - Flags dienen nur dem Screening

    # QC nur sinnvoll wenn mindestens 2 Paare verfuegbar
    if (nrow(cross_method_mapping) >= 2) {

      # Hilfsfunktion: QC-Metriken fuer ein Paar berechnen
      compute_pair_qc <- function(df, cib_col, mcp_col, pair_name) {
        x <- df[[cib_col]]
        y <- df[[mcp_col]]
        complete_idx <- complete.cases(x, y)
        n_complete <- sum(complete_idx)

        if (n_complete < 5) {
          return(tibble::tibble(
            pair_name = pair_name,
            cibersort_col = cib_col,
            mcp_col = mcp_col,
            n_complete = n_complete,
            spearman_rho = NA_real_,
            pearson_r = NA_real_,
            qc_flag = "insufficient_data"
          ))
        }

        x_c <- x[complete_idx]
        y_c <- y[complete_idx]

        r_spearman <- cor(x_c, y_c, method = "spearman")
        r_pearson <- cor(x_c, y_c, method = "pearson")

        # Heuristisches Flagging (konservativ, nur fuer Screening)
        # Primaer auf Spearman basiert (weil MCP scores != fractions)
        # "discordant": Spearman klar negativ
        # "weak": Spearman nahe Null
        # "ok": Spearman positiv
        qc_flag <- dplyr::case_when(
          r_spearman < -0.1 ~ "discordant",
          abs(r_spearman) < 0.15 ~ "weak",
          TRUE ~ "ok"
        )

        # Spaltenreihenfolge: spearman_rho ZUERST (primaer)
        tibble::tibble(
          pair_name = pair_name,
          cibersort_col = cib_col,
          mcp_col = mcp_col,
          n_complete = n_complete,
          spearman_rho = round(r_spearman, 3),
          pearson_r = round(r_pearson, 3),
          qc_flag = qc_flag
        )
      }

      # QC fuer alle Paare berechnen
      cross_method_qc <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
        list(
          cib_col = cross_method_mapping$cibersort_col,
          mcp_col = cross_method_mapping$mcp_col,
          pair_name = cross_method_mapping$pair_name
        ),
        function(cib_col, mcp_col, pair_name) {
          compute_pair_qc(clinical_deconv_merged, cib_col, mcp_col, pair_name)
        }
      )

      message("\n--- CROSS-METHOD QC TABELLE ---")
      message("MCP scores != CIBERSORT fractions -> Spearman (Rang) primaer, Pearson sekundaer")
      message("(Flags sind heuristisch - Screening/QC, nicht pass/fail)")
      safe_print(cross_method_qc)

      # QC Tabelle speichern
      qc_table_path <- file.path(clinical_output_dir, "deconv_cross_method_qc.csv")
      tryCatch({
        write.csv(cross_method_qc, qc_table_path, row.names = FALSE)
        message("Gespeichert: ", qc_table_path)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("WARNUNG: QC-Tabelle konnte nicht gespeichert werden: ", conditionMessage(e))
      })

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # C3: Scatterplots fuer visuelle Bewertung
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Facettierte Scatterplots mit Loess-Trend, gefaerbt nach Zeitpunkt

      tryCatch({
        # Prepare long-format data for plotting
        plot_data <- clinical_deconv_merged %>%
          dplyr::select(sample_id) %>%
          dplyr::left_join(
            sample_meta_clinical %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, timepoint, pid),
            by = "sample_id"
          )

        # Add pair columns
        scatter_data_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cross_method_mapping)), function(i) {
          pair <- cross_method_mapping[i, ]
          tibble::tibble(
            sample_id = clinical_deconv_merged$sample_id,
            pair_name = pair$pair_name,
            cibersort_value = clinical_deconv_merged[[pair$cibersort_col]],
            mcp_value = clinical_deconv_merged[[pair$mcp_col]]
          )
        })
        scatter_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(scatter_data_list) %>%
          dplyr::left_join(plot_data, by = "sample_id") %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(cibersort_value), !is.na(mcp_value))

        # QC-Info zu Facet-Labels hinzufuegen (Spearman zuerst!)
        scatter_data <- scatter_data %>%
          dplyr::left_join(
            cross_method_qc %>% dplyr::select(pair_name, spearman_rho, pearson_r, qc_flag),
            by = "pair_name"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            facet_label = paste0(pair_name, "\nrho=", spearman_rho, ", r=", pearson_r,
                                 " [", qc_flag, "]")
          )

        # Facettierter Scatterplot erstellen
        p_scatter <- ggplot2::ggplot(
          scatter_data,
          ggplot2::aes(x = mcp_value, y = cibersort_value, color = timepoint)
        ) +
          ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
          ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
          ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ facet_label, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
          ggplot2::labs(
            title = "Cross-Method Validation: CIBERSORT vs MCP-counter",
            subtitle = "Screening/QC - Spearman (rho) primaer weil MCP scores != fractions",
            x = "MCP-counter Score (Enrichment)",
            y = "CIBERSORT Fraction",
            color = "Zeitpunkt"
          ) +
          ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
          ggplot2::theme(
            strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
            legend.position = "bottom"
          )

        scatter_path <- file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "deconv_cross_method_scatter.pdf")
        ggplot2::ggsave(scatter_path, p_scatter, width = 10, height = 8)
        message("Gespeichert: ", scatter_path)

      }, error = function(e) {
        message("WARNUNG: Scatterplots konnten nicht erstellt werden: ", conditionMessage(e))
      })

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # C4: Zeit-Delta Konsistenz (Patienten-Level)
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # WICHTIG fuer longitudinale Daten!
      # Delta-QC reduziert kompositionelle Artefakte durch Vergleich
      # von AENDERUNGEN innerhalb von Patienten.
      # -> Weniger anfaellig fuer Baseline-Unterschiede zwischen Methoden

      message("\n--- ZEIT-DELTA KONSISTENZ ANALYSE ---")
      message("Vergleiche Patienten-Level Deltas zwischen Methoden")
      message("(Delta-QC ist wichtig fuer longitudinale Aussagen!)")

      delta_qc <- NULL
      tryCatch({
        # Zeitpunkt-Info hinzufuegen
        deconv_with_meta <- clinical_deconv_merged %>%
          dplyr::left_join(
            sample_meta_clinical %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, timepoint, pid),
            by = "sample_id"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(timepoint), !is.na(pid))

        # Hilfsfunktion: Deltas fuer ein Paar berechnen
        compute_delta_qc <- function(df, cib_col, mcp_col, pair_name, tp1, tp2) {
          df_wide <- df %>%
            dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c(tp1, tp2)) %>%
            dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, cib_val = !!rlang::sym(cib_col),
                          mcp_val = !!rlang::sym(mcp_col)) %>%
            tidyr::pivot_wider(
              names_from = timepoint,
              values_from = c(cib_val, mcp_val)
            )

          cib_t1 <- paste0("cib_val_", tp1)
          cib_t2 <- paste0("cib_val_", tp2)
          mcp_t1 <- paste0("mcp_val_", tp1)
          mcp_t2 <- paste0("mcp_val_", tp2)

          if (!all(c(cib_t1, cib_t2, mcp_t1, mcp_t2) %in% names(df_wide))) {
            return(NULL)
          }

          df_wide <- df_wide %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
              delta_cib = .data[[cib_t2]] - .data[[cib_t1]],
              delta_mcp = .data[[mcp_t2]] - .data[[mcp_t1]]
            ) %>%
            dplyr::filter(!is.na(delta_cib), !is.na(delta_mcp))

          n_patients <- nrow(df_wide)
          if (n_patients < 5) return(NULL)

          # Spearman zuerst (primaer), dann Pearson
          r_spearman <- cor(df_wide$delta_cib, df_wide$delta_mcp, method = "spearman")
          r_pearson <- cor(df_wide$delta_cib, df_wide$delta_mcp, method = "pearson")

          # Spaltenreihenfolge: spearman zuerst!
          tibble::tibble(
            pair_name = pair_name,
            comparison = paste0(tp2, "-", tp1),
            n_patients = n_patients,
            delta_spearman_rho = round(r_spearman, 3),
            delta_pearson_r = round(r_pearson, 3)
          )
        }

        # Deltas fuer alle Paare und Zeitpunkt-Vergleiche berechnen
        delta_comparisons <- list(
          c("A", "V1"),
          c("V1", "V2"),
          c("A", "V2")
        )

        delta_qc_list <- list()
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(cross_method_mapping))) {
          pair <- cross_method_mapping[i, ]
          for (comp in delta_comparisons) {
            result <- compute_delta_qc(
              deconv_with_meta,
              pair$cibersort_col, pair$mcp_col, pair$pair_name,
              comp[1], comp[2]
            )
            if (!is.null(result)) {
              delta_qc_list <- c(delta_qc_list, list(result))
            }
          }
        }

        if (length(delta_qc_list) > 0) {
          delta_qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(delta_qc_list)
          message("\n--- DELTA QC TABELLE (Patienten-Level Aenderungen) ---")
          message("Spearman (delta_spearman_rho) primaer fuer longitudinale Konsistenz")
          safe_print(delta_qc)

          # Delta QC Tabelle speichern
          delta_qc_path <- file.path(clinical_output_dir, "deconv_cross_method_delta_qc.csv")
          write.csv(delta_qc, delta_qc_path, row.names = FALSE)
          message("Gespeichert: ", delta_qc_path)

        } else {
          message("WARNUNG: Zu wenige gepaarte Samples fuer Delta-Analyse")
        }

      }, error = function(e) {
        message("WARNUNG: Delta-Analyse fehlgeschlagen: ", conditionMessage(e))
      })

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # C5: Summary Plot (Korrelations-Uebersicht)
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Spearman zuerst (primaer), Pearson sekundaer

      tryCatch({
        # Korrelations-Barplot erstellen (Spearman primaer)
        summary_data <- cross_method_qc %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(
            cols = c(spearman_rho, pearson_r),  # Spearman zuerst!
            names_to = "metric",
            values_to = "correlation"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            metric = factor(
              dplyr::case_when(
                metric == "spearman_rho" ~ "Spearman rho (primaer)",
                metric == "pearson_r" ~ "Pearson r (sekundaer)"
              ),
              levels = c("Spearman rho (primaer)", "Pearson r (sekundaer)")
            )
          )

        p_summary <- ggplot2::ggplot(
          summary_data,
          ggplot2::aes(x = pair_name, y = correlation, fill = metric)
        ) +
          ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
          ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
          ggplot2::coord_flip() +
          ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
            values = c("Spearman rho (primaer)" = "#e74c3c",
                       "Pearson r (sekundaer)" = "#3498db")
          ) +
          ggplot2::labs(
            title = "Cross-Method Korrelation: CIBERSORT vs MCP-counter",
            subtitle = "MCP scores != fractions -> Spearman (Rang-basiert) ist primaer",
            x = "Zelltyp-Paar",
            y = "Korrelationskoeffizient",
            fill = "Metrik"
          ) +
          ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
          ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

        summary_path <- file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "deconv_cross_method_summary.pdf")
        ggplot2::ggsave(summary_path, p_summary, width = 8, height = 5)
        message("Gespeichert: ", summary_path)

      }, error = function(e) {
        message("WARNUNG: Summary-Plot konnte nicht erstellt werden: ", conditionMessage(e))
      })

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # C6: Cell-Type Adjustment Entscheidung (Nicht-Binaer)
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Keine automatischen "empfohlen/nicht empfohlen" Entscheidungen.
      # Stattdessen: qualitative Zusammenfassung fuer Sensitivity-Analyse.
      # Flags basieren primaer auf Spearman (weil MCP scores != fractions).

      message("\n=== CELL-TYPE ADJUSTMENT ENTSCHEIDUNG (Nicht-Binaer) ===")
      message("(Flags basieren auf Spearman - primaer fuer MCP vs CIBERSORT)")

      n_ok <- sum(cross_method_qc$qc_flag == "ok")
      n_weak <- sum(cross_method_qc$qc_flag == "weak")
      n_discordant <- sum(cross_method_qc$qc_flag == "discordant")
      n_insufficient <- sum(cross_method_qc$qc_flag == "insufficient_data")
      n_total <- nrow(cross_method_qc)

      # Gesamt-QC-Status bestimmen (heuristisch)
      if (n_discordant > 0) {
        qc_overall_status <- "mixed_discordant"
      } else if (n_ok >= n_total / 2) {
        qc_overall_status <- "mostly_consistent"
      } else if (n_weak >= n_total / 2) {
        qc_overall_status <- "mixed_weak"
      } else {
        qc_overall_status <- "mixed"
      }

      message("QC Zusammenfassung: ", n_ok, " ok, ", n_weak, " schwach, ",
              n_discordant, " diskordant, ", n_insufficient, " unzureichend")
      message("Gesamt-QC-Status: ", qc_overall_status)

      # Entscheidungshilfe (nicht automatisch)
      message("\n--- EMPFEHLUNG (keine automatischen Entscheidungen) ---")
      if (qc_overall_status == "mostly_consistent") {
        message("  -> Methoden zeigen gute Uebereinstimmung")
        message("  -> Cell-type adjustment KANN als Sensitivity-Analyse genutzt werden")
        message("  -> Als zusaetzliche Modellvariante, nicht zwingend primaer")
      } else if (qc_overall_status %in% c("mixed_weak", "mixed")) {
        message("  -> Methoden zeigen gemischte/schwache Uebereinstimmung")
        message("  -> Cell-type adjustment nur als EXPLORATIVE Sensitivity")
        message("  -> Als Limitation im Methods-Abschnitt dokumentieren")
      } else {
        message("  -> Einige Zelltypen zeigen diskordante Muster")
        message("  -> Cell-type adjustment NICHT als primaere Analyse empfohlen")
        message("  -> Falls verwendet: als explorativ mit expliziten Einschraenkungen")
      }

      # QC-Ergebnisse fuer nachgelagerte Nutzung speichern
      clinical_deconv_qc_summary <- list(
        qc_table = cross_method_qc,
        delta_qc = delta_qc,
        overall_status = qc_overall_status,
        n_ok = n_ok,
        n_weak = n_weak,
        n_discordant = n_discordant
      )

    } else {
      message("WARNUNG: Weniger als 2 Cross-Method-Paare verfuegbar - QC uebersprungen")
      clinical_deconv_qc_summary <- NULL
    }

    # Combined Daten speichern
    clinical_deconv_combined <- clinical_deconv_merged
    saveRDS(clinical_deconv_combined, clinical_deconv_cache_combined)
    message("\nCombined Deconvolution gespeichert")

  } else {
    message("\nWARNUNG: Cross-Validation nicht moeglich (eine Methode fehlgeschlagen)")

    # Nutze verfuegbare Methode
    if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide)) {
      clinical_deconv_combined <- clinical_deconv_cibersort_wide
    } else if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_mcp_wide)) {
      clinical_deconv_combined <- clinical_deconv_mcp_wide
    } else {
      clinical_deconv_combined <- NULL
    }

    if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_combined)) {
      saveRDS(clinical_deconv_combined, clinical_deconv_cache_combined)
    }

    clinical_deconv_qc_summary <- NULL
  }

  # ============================================================
  # STEP 6: Merge mit sample_meta_clinical
  # ============================================================

if (!is.null(clinical_deconv_combined)) {

  n_before <- nrow(sample_meta_clinical)

  # Normalize join keys
  sample_meta_clinical$sample_id <- trimws(as.character(sample_meta_clinical$sample_id))
  clinical_deconv_combined$sample_id <- trimws(as.character(clinical_deconv_combined$sample_id))

  # Rerun-safety: entferne alte CIBERSORT_/MCP_ Spalten
  if (any(grepl("^CIBERSORT_|^MCP_", names(sample_meta_clinical)))) {
    message("⚠️ Deconvolution-Spalten existieren bereits -> entferne vor erneutem Join")
    sample_meta_clinical <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
      dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("^CIBERSORT_|^MCP_"))
  }

  message("\n--- DECONV JOIN DIAGNOSTICS ---")
  message("  sample_meta_clinical: ", n_before, " samples")
  message("  deconv_combined: ", nrow(clinical_deconv_combined), " samples")
  message("  Overlap: ",
          sum(sample_meta_clinical$sample_id %in% clinical_deconv_combined$sample_id),
          " / ", n_before)

  # Join
  sample_meta_clinical <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    dplyr::left_join(clinical_deconv_combined, by = "sample_id")

  stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta_clinical) == n_before)

  # Anzahl gemappter Samples
  deconv_cols <- grep("^CIBERSORT_|^MCP_", names(sample_meta_clinical), value = TRUE)

  if (length(deconv_cols) > 0) {
    n_with_deconv <- sum(rowSums(!is.na(sample_meta_clinical[, deconv_cols, drop = FALSE])) > 0)
    message("✓ Deconvolution-Features hinzugefügt: ", n_with_deconv, " / ",
            n_before, " samples (", round(n_with_deconv/n_before*100, 1), "%)")
  } else {
    message("⚠️ Keine Deconvolution-Features verfügbar")
  }

  # === PLAUSIBILITÄTSPRÜFUNG ===
  # Erwartung: Monozyten steigen akut nach TAVI (V1 > A)
  # ABER: Inkonsistenz mit Pathway-Analyse muss geprüft werden

  if ("CIBERSORT_Monocyte" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical)) {

    clinical_mono_check <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
      dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1"), !is.na(CIBERSORT_Monocyte)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        mean_mono = mean(CIBERSORT_Monocyte, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_mono   = sd(CIBERSORT_Monocyte, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    message("\n--- PLAUSIBILITÄTSPRÜFUNG: Monocytes (CIBERSORT) ---")
    safe_print(clinical_mono_check)

    mono_V1 <- clinical_mono_check$mean_mono[clinical_mono_check$timepoint == "V1"]
    mono_A  <- clinical_mono_check$mean_mono[clinical_mono_check$timepoint == "A"]

    clinical_monocyte_plausible <- (mono_V1 > mono_A)

    if (isTRUE(clinical_monocyte_plausible)) {
      message("✓ Monocytes: V1 > A (biologisch plausibel)")
      message("  → CIBERSORT-Schätzungen konsistent mit Inflammation ↑")
      message("  → Cell-type Adjustment kann verwendet werden")
    } else {
      message("⚠️ KRITISCH: Monocytes V1 ≤ A")
      message("  → Inkonsistent mit Pathway-Analyse (Inflammation V1 > A)")
      message("  → Mögliche Ursachen:")
      message("     1. Compositional constraint (Neutrophile steigen stark → Monozyten relativ ↓)")
      message("     2. Technisches Artefakt")
      message("  → EMPFEHLUNG: Prüfe Neutrophile & T-Zellen für Konsistenz")
      message("  → Cell-type Adjustment NUR verwenden wenn andere Zelltypen plausibel")
      clinical_monocyte_plausible <- FALSE
    }

    # Prüfe Neutrophile (sollten steigen nach TAVI)
    if ("CIBERSORT_Neutrophil" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical)) {
      clinical_neutro_check <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
        dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1"), !is.na(CIBERSORT_Neutrophil)) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          mean_neutro = mean(CIBERSORT_Neutrophil, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      neutro_V1 <- clinical_neutro_check$mean_neutro[clinical_neutro_check$timepoint == "V1"]
      neutro_A  <- clinical_neutro_check$mean_neutro[clinical_neutro_check$timepoint == "A"]

      message("\n  Neutrophils: A = ", round(neutro_A, 3), ", V1 = ", round(neutro_V1, 3))

      if (neutro_V1 > neutro_A) {
        message("  → Neutrophile steigen (V1 > A) — konsistent mit akuter Inflammation")
        message("  → Monozyten-Reduktion könnte compositional constraint sein")
      } else {
        message("  → Neutrophile steigen NICHT — inkonsistent mit Inflammation")
      }
    }

    # ============================================================
    # ADD-ON CHECKS
    # ============================================================

    message("\n--- ADD-ON PLAUSIBILITY CHECKS: T cells & Neutrophils (A vs V1) ---")

    # (1) CIBERSORT T-cell total (sum of all CIBERSORT_T_cell_* subtypes)
    tcell_cols_cib <- grep("^CIBERSORT_T_cell", names(sample_meta_clinical), value = TRUE)

    if (length(tcell_cols_cib) > 0) {

      clinical_tcell_check <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
        dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1")) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(CIBERSORT_T_cell_total = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(tcell_cols_cib)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          mean_tcell = mean(CIBERSORT_T_cell_total, na.rm = TRUE),
          sd_tcell   = sd(CIBERSORT_T_cell_total, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      message("\n--- PLAUSIBILITÄTSPRÜFUNG: T cells total (CIBERSORT) ---")
      safe_print(clinical_tcell_check)

    } else {
      message("⚠️ Keine CIBERSORT_T_cell* Spalten gefunden → T-cell-total Check übersprungen")
    }

    # (2) CIBERSORT Neutrophil (A→V1) summary (Mean + SD; statt nur Mean)
    if ("CIBERSORT_Neutrophil" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical)) {

      clinical_neutro_check2 <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
        dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1"), !is.na(CIBERSORT_Neutrophil)) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          mean_neutro = mean(CIBERSORT_Neutrophil, na.rm = TRUE),
          sd_neutro   = sd(CIBERSORT_Neutrophil, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      message("\n--- PLAUSIBILITÄTSPRÜFUNG: Neutrophils (CIBERSORT; mean±sd) ---")
      safe_print(clinical_neutro_check2)

    } else {
      message("⚠️ CIBERSORT_Neutrophil nicht vorhanden → Neutrophil summary übersprungen")
    }

    # (3) OPTIONAL: MCP Monocyte (A→V1) check (score-based; no compositional constraint)
    message("\n--- OPTIONAL CHECK: Monocytes (MCP) (A vs V1) ---")

    mcp_mono_candidates <- c("MCP_Monocyte", "MCP_Monocytic_lineage", "MCP_Macrophage/Monocyte")
    mcp_mono_col <- mcp_mono_candidates[mcp_mono_candidates %in% names(sample_meta_clinical)][1]

    if (!is.na(mcp_mono_col)) {

      clinical_mcp_mono_check <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
        dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1")) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[mcp_mono_col]])) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          mean_mcp_mono = mean(.data[[mcp_mono_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
          sd_mcp_mono   = sd(.data[[mcp_mono_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      message("Using MCP monocyte column: ", mcp_mono_col)
      safe_print(clinical_mcp_mono_check)

    } else {
      message("⚠️ Keine MCP-Monozyten-Spalte gefunden (erwartet eine von: ",
              paste(mcp_mono_candidates, collapse = ", "), ")")
    }

  } else {
    clinical_monocyte_plausible <- NA
    message("⚠️ CIBERSORT_Monocyte nicht vorhanden")
  }

  message("   → Cell-type features hinzugefügt zu sample_meta_clinical")

} else {
  message("⚠️ Deconvolution nicht durchgeführt → wird als Limitation dokumentiert")
  message("   Begründung: CIBERSORT/MCP-counter nicht verfügbar oder fehlgeschlagen")
  }
}

```
