# SCHRITT 6: Pathway-Definition & GSVA-Berechnung

**Ziel:** A-priori Pathway-Sets definieren, GSVA-Scores berechnen

**Pathway-Gruppen:**
1. Inflammation: HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE, GO_INNATE_IMMUNE_RESPONSE
2. Ribosome: KEGG_RIBOSOME, HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1, GO_TRANSLATIONAL_INITIATION
3. Adaptive Immunity: GO_T_CELL_ACTIVATION, GO_B_CELL_MEDIATED_IMMUNITY, HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING

```{r}
#| label: step6-gsva-pathways
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 6: GSVA Pathway-Scores ===")

# ============================================================
# Ziel: Lade GSVA-Scores aus DEanalysis.qmd, selektiere A-priori Pathways
# A-priori Basis: Schmader et al. 2021, Kuppe et al. 2024, RESULTS_STORY.md
# Literatur: Hänzelmann et al. 2013 (GSVA original)
# ============================================================

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_gsva_composite_cache <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "gsva_composite_scores.rds")

if (file.exists(clinical_gsva_composite_cache)) {
  message("✅ Lade GSVA Composite Cache: ", clinical_gsva_composite_cache)
  clinical_gsva_composite <- readRDS(clinical_gsva_composite_cache)

} else {
  message("⏳ Berechne GSVA Composite-Scores...")

  # ============================================================
  # GSVA-Cache aus DEanalysis.qmd laden
  # ============================================================

  clinical_gsva_cache_path <- "../../../res/cache/gsva_hallmark_scores.rds"

  if (!file.exists(clinical_gsva_cache_path)) {
    stop(
      "❌ GSVA-Cache nicht gefunden.",
      "\n   Erwarteter Pfad: ", clinical_gsva_cache_path,
      "\n   Bitte erst DEanalysis.qmd Chunk 'gsva-hallmark' ausführen."
    )
  }

  clinical_gsva_scores <- readRDS(clinical_gsva_cache_path)
  message("✓ GSVA-Scores geladen: ", nrow(clinical_gsva_scores), " pathways × ",
          ncol(clinical_gsva_scores), " samples")

  # ============================================================
  # A-priori Pathway-Selektion (literatur-basiert)
  # ============================================================

  # Pathway-Definition basierend auf:
  # 1. RESULTS_STORY.md: Biphasische Ribosomen-Signatur, Inflammation, Adaptive Immunity
  # 2. Schmader 2021: Inflammation + Interferon als Composite
  # 3. Kuppe 2024: Myeloid-Lymphoid-Shift
  # 4. CLINICAL_INTEGRATION_REVIEW.md: GO terms + MSigDB Hallmarks

  clinical_pathways_apriori <- list(
    inflammation = c(
      # Hallmarks
      "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
      "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING",
      # GO terms
      "GO_INNATE_IMMUNE_RESPONSE",
      "GO_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
      "GO_ACUTE_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE"
    ),
    ribosome = c(
      # Hallmarks
      "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1",        # Ribosomale Biogenese
      # KEGG
      "KEGG_RIBOSOME",
      # GO terms
      "GO_RIBOSOME",
      "GO_TRANSLATIONAL_INITIATION",
      "GO_TRANSLATION",
      "GO_RIBOSOME_BIOGENESIS"
    ),
    adaptive = c(
      # Hallmarks
      "HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING",
      "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION",   # T-Zell-Aktivierung
      # GO terms
      "GO_T_CELL_ACTIVATION",
      "GO_B_CELL_MEDIATED_IMMUNITY",
      "GO_ADAPTIVE_IMMUNE_RESPONSE",
      "GO_LYMPHOCYTE_ACTIVATION"
    ),
    interferon = c(
      # Hallmarks (ohne Duplikate aus adaptive)
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE",
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE",
      # GO terms
      "GO_RESPONSE_TO_INTERFERON_GAMMA",
      "GO_TYPE_I_INTERFERON_SIGNALING_PATHWAY"
    )
  )

  # Prüfe, welche Pathways verfügbar sind
  clinical_available_pathways <- rownames(clinical_gsva_scores)
  clinical_missing_pathways <- setdiff(
    unlist(clinical_pathways_apriori),
    clinical_available_pathways
  )

  if (length(clinical_missing_pathways) > 0) {
    message("⚠️ Fehlende Pathways in GSVA-Ergebnissen:")
    for (pw in clinical_missing_pathways) {
      message("  - ", pw)
    }
    message("   → Composite-Scores basieren nur auf verfügbaren Pathways")
  }

  # Dokumentiere verwendete Pathways
  clinical_pathways_used <- lapply(clinical_pathways_apriori, function(pws) {
    intersect(pws, clinical_available_pathways)
  })

  message("\n--- VERWENDETE PATHWAYS PRO GRUPPE ---")
  for (group_name in names(clinical_pathways_used)) {
    message(sprintf("  %s (%d pathways):", group_name, length(clinical_pathways_used[[group_name]])))
    for (pw in clinical_pathways_used[[group_name]]) {
      message("    - ", pw)
    }
  }

  # === COMPOSITE-SCORES (Mittelwert pro Gruppe) ===
  # Methodik: Gleichgewichteter Mittelwert aller Pathways pro Gruppe
  # Rationale:
  #   - PCA-basierte Composite (PC1) wäre datengetrieben und schwer interpretierbar
  #   - Mittelwert ist transparent und in klinischer Literatur etabliert
  #     (Schmader et al. 2021: gleichgewichteter Inflammation-Score)
  #   - Validierung: cor(PC1, Mean) ≥ 0.8 zeigt, dass Mittelwert Hauptvarianz erfasst
  #
  # Alternative (falls cor < 0.8): PC1 verwenden oder Pathway-Gewichtung anpassen

  # Sichere Mittelwert-Funktion (handhabt fehlende Pathways)
  clinical_safe_colmeans <- function(gsva_mat, pathways) {
    present <- intersect(pathways, rownames(gsva_mat))
    if (length(present) == 0) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(gsva_mat)))
    }
    if (length(present) == 1) {
      return(gsva_mat[present, ])
    }
    colMeans(gsva_mat[present, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  clinical_gsva_composite <- data.frame(
    sample_id = colnames(clinical_gsva_scores),
    clinical_inflammation_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$inflammation
    ),
    clinical_ribosome_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$ribosome
    ),
    clinical_adaptive_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$adaptive
    ),
    clinical_interferon_score = clinical_safe_colmeans(
      clinical_gsva_scores,
      clinical_pathways_used$interferon
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # ============================================================
  # PCA-COMPOSITE VALIDATION (Issue M.3)
  # Prüfe ob PC1 ≈ Mittelwert-Score (validiert Gleichgewichtung)
  # ============================================================

  message("\n--- PCA COMPOSITE VALIDATION ---")

  for (group_name in names(clinical_pathways_used)) {
    # Extrahiere Pathways für diese Gruppe
    group_pathways <- clinical_pathways_used[[group_name]]
    present_pathways <- intersect(group_pathways, rownames(clinical_gsva_scores))

    if (length(present_pathways) >= 2) {
      # PCA auf Pathway-Scores
      pathway_matrix <- t(clinical_gsva_scores[present_pathways, , drop = FALSE])
      pca_result <- tryCatch({
        prcomp(pathway_matrix, scale. = FALSE, center = TRUE)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      if (!is.null(pca_result)) {
        pc1 <- pca_result$x[, 1]
        # Korrelation zwischen PC1 und Mittelwert-Score
        mean_score <- rowMeans(pathway_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
        cor_pc1_mean <- cor(pc1, mean_score, use = "complete.obs")
        var_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1] * 100

        message(sprintf("  %s: PC1 vs Mean r = %.3f, PC1 var explained = %.1f%%",
                        group_name, cor_pc1_mean, var_explained))

        if (abs(cor_pc1_mean) < 0.8) {
          message(sprintf("    ⚠️  Niedrige Korrelation — Mittelwert könnte Information verlieren"))
          message(sprintf("    → Erwäge PC1-Composite statt Mittelwert"))
        } else {
          message(sprintf("    ✓  Mittelwert ist valide Zusammenfassung (|r| ≥ 0.8)"))
        }
      }
    } else {
      message(sprintf("  %s: Nur %d Pathway(s) - PCA nicht durchgeführt",
                      group_name, length(present_pathways)))
    }
  }

  # Debug: Show composite scores
  message("\n--- GSVA COMPOSITE CREATED ---")
  message("  Samples: ", nrow(clinical_gsva_composite))
  message("  First 3 sample_ids: ", paste(head(clinical_gsva_composite$sample_id, 3), collapse = ", "))
  message("  First 3 inflammation scores: ", paste(round(head(clinical_gsva_composite$clinical_inflammation_score, 3), 3), collapse = ", "))

  # Range-Validierung
  clinical_score_ranges <- clinical_gsva_composite %>%
    dplyr::select(-sample_id) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE),
      mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      na_count = ~sum(is.na(.))
    )))

  message("\n--- COMPOSITE-SCORE RANGES ---")
  safe_print(clinical_score_ranges)

  # Warnung bei zu vielen NAs
  na_threshold <- 0.1
  for (col in names(clinical_gsva_composite)[-1]) {
    na_pct <- mean(is.na(clinical_gsva_composite[[col]]))
    if (na_pct > na_threshold) {
      warning(sprintf("⚠️ %s: %.1f%% NAs (Schwelle: %.0f%%)",
                      col, na_pct * 100, na_threshold * 100))
    }
  }

  # Speichere Cache
  saveRDS(clinical_gsva_composite, clinical_gsva_composite_cache)
  message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_gsva_composite_cache)
}

# ============================================================
# Merge mit sample_meta_clinical
# ============================================================

n_before <- nrow(sample_meta_clinical)

# Debug: Check sample_id overlap
message("\n--- GSVA JOIN DIAGNOSTICS ---")
message("  sample_meta_clinical: ", n_before, " samples")
message("  First 3 sample_ids: ",
        paste(head(sample_meta_clinical$sample_id, 3), collapse = ", "))
message("  gsva_composite: ", nrow(clinical_gsva_composite), " samples")
message("  First 3 sample_ids: ",
        paste(head(clinical_gsva_composite$sample_id, 3), collapse = ", "))
message("  Overlap: ",
        sum(sample_meta_clinical$sample_id %in% clinical_gsva_composite$sample_id),
        " / ", n_before)

sample_meta_clinical <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  left_join(clinical_gsva_composite, by = "sample_id")

# Validierung
stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta_clinical) == n_before)

n_with_gsva <- sum(!is.na(sample_meta_clinical$clinical_inflammation_score))
message("✓ GSVA composite scores hinzugefügt: ", n_with_gsva, " / ", n_before,
        " samples (", round(n_with_gsva/n_before*100, 1), "%)")

# Note: Complete-case dataset wird nach allen Joins (Step 7) final definiert
message("   → GSVA composite scores hinzugefügt zu sample_meta_clinical")

saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical_gsva.rds"))
```

# SCHRITT 7: Delta-Variablen

**Ziel:** Patient-level Deltas für V1-A, V2-V1, V2-A berechnen

```{r}
#| label: step7-delta-variables
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 7: Delta-Variablen ===")

# === DELTA-VARIABLEN (Sensitivity Analysis) ===
# Zweck: Alternative Analyse-Strategie, NICHT primäre Methode
#
# Limitation von Change-Scores (Literatur):
#   - Regression to mean → negative slope bias (Castro-Schilo & Grimm 2018)
#   - Interpretation schwierig: Baseline auf beiden Seiten der Gleichung
#   - Weniger Power als Mixed Models (-12% unter MCAR, Mallinckrodt 2008)
#
# Verwendung:
#   - Sensitivity Check für LMM-Ergebnisse
#   - Paired t-tests (explorativ): z.B. "Inflammation V1 vs A"
#   - Grafische Darstellung (patient-level Trajektorien)
#
# NICHT verwenden für:
#   - Primäre statistische Inferenz
#   - Regression mit Change-Score als abhängige Variable (Bias!)
#
# Literatur:
#   - Castro-Schilo & Grimm 2018 (J Soc Pers Relat)
#   - Mallinckrodt et al. 2008 (NCBI NBK538904)
#   - Senn et al. 2009 (PMC2678722)

# Cache-Pfad
clinical_delta_cache <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "delta_data_clinical.rds")

if (file.exists(clinical_delta_cache)) {
  message("✅ Lade Delta Cache: ", clinical_delta_cache)
  clinical_delta_data <- readRDS(clinical_delta_cache)

} else {
  message("⏳ Berechne Delta-Variablen...")

  # ============================================================
  # Delta-Berechnung (pro Patient, pro Pathway)
  # ============================================================

  # Selektiere relevante Spalten
  clinical_delta_long <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pid, timepoint,
      clinical_inflammation_score,
      clinical_ribosome_score,
      clinical_adaptive_score,
      clinical_interferon_score
    )

  # Pivot zu Wide (ein Patient pro Zeile, Zeitpunkte als Spalten)
  clinical_delta_wide <- clinical_delta_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = pid,
      names_from = timepoint,
      values_from = c(
        clinical_inflammation_score,
        clinical_ribosome_score,
        clinical_adaptive_score,
        clinical_interferon_score
      )
    )

  # Delta-Berechnung
  clinical_delta_data <- clinical_delta_wide %>%
    mutate(
      # Inflammation Deltas
      clinical_delta_inflammation_V1_A = clinical_inflammation_score_V1 - clinical_inflammation_score_A,
      clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_V1 = clinical_inflammation_score_V2 - clinical_inflammation_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_A = clinical_inflammation_score_V2 - clinical_inflammation_score_A,

      # Ribosome Deltas
      clinical_delta_ribosome_V1_A = clinical_ribosome_score_V1 - clinical_ribosome_score_A,
      clinical_delta_ribosome_V2_V1 = clinical_ribosome_score_V2 - clinical_ribosome_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_ribosome_V2_A = clinical_ribosome_score_V2 - clinical_ribosome_score_A,

      # Adaptive Deltas
      clinical_delta_adaptive_V1_A = clinical_adaptive_score_V1 - clinical_adaptive_score_A,
      clinical_delta_adaptive_V2_V1 = clinical_adaptive_score_V2 - clinical_adaptive_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_adaptive_V2_A = clinical_adaptive_score_V2 - clinical_adaptive_score_A,

      # Interferon Deltas
      clinical_delta_interferon_V1_A = clinical_interferon_score_V1 - clinical_interferon_score_A,
      clinical_delta_interferon_V2_V1 = clinical_interferon_score_V2 - clinical_interferon_score_V1,
      clinical_delta_interferon_V2_A = clinical_interferon_score_V2 - clinical_interferon_score_A
    )

  # Merge mit klinischen Baseline-Daten (patient-level)
  clinical_delta_data <- clinical_delta_data %>%
    left_join(clinical_clean, by = "pid")

  # Validierung: Anzahl Patienten
  n_patients_delta <- nrow(clinical_delta_data)
  n_expected <- n_distinct(sample_meta_clinical$pid[
    !is.na(sample_meta_clinical$age) &
      !is.na(sample_meta_clinical$clinical_inflammation_score)
  ])

  message(sprintf("✓ Delta variables calculated for %d patients (erwartet: %d)",
                  n_patients_delta, n_expected))

  # Prüfe auf fehlende Werte
  clinical_delta_completeness <- clinical_delta_data %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_complete_V1_A = sum(!is.na(clinical_delta_inflammation_V1_A)),
      n_complete_V2_V1 = sum(!is.na(clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_V1)),
      n_complete_V2_A = sum(!is.na(clinical_delta_inflammation_V2_A))
    )

  message("\n--- DELTA COMPLETENESS ---")
  safe_print(clinical_delta_completeness)

  if (clinical_delta_completeness$n_complete_V1_A < n_patients_delta * 0.9) {
    warning("⚠️ >10% fehlende Deltas V1-A — prüfe Dropout-Pattern")
  }

  # Range-Validierung (Deltas sollten sinnvoll sein)
  clinical_delta_ranges <- clinical_delta_data %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with("clinical_delta_")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE),
      mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)
    )))

  message("\n--- DELTA RANGES (INFLAMMATION) ---")
  clinical_delta_ranges %>%
    dplyr::select(contains("inflammation")) %>%
    print()

  # Speichere Cache
  saveRDS(clinical_delta_data, clinical_delta_cache)
  message("💾 Gespeichert: ", clinical_delta_cache)
}

message("✓ Delta-Daten verfügbar für patient-level Analysen")

# === FINAL COMPLETE-CASE DATASET ===
# Definiere complete-case EINMALIG nach allen Feature-Joins
# Kriterien:
#   - Complete triplets (A + V1 + V2 vorhanden)
#   - Klinische Basisdaten vorhanden (age nicht NA)
#   - GSVA scores vorhanden (inflammation_score nicht NA)
#
# Methodische Basis (Literatur):
#   - Complete-case ist unbiased unter MCAR (PMC3016756)
#   - ABER: Mixed models haben +12% Power (BMC 2016)
#   - Complete-case: "Loss of precision" (NCBI NBK538904)
#   - MCAR-Test (Step 4) validiert dass Dropout nicht biased ist
#
# Verwendung:
#   - Primary Analyses: Linear Mixed Models (nutzen alle Daten)
#   - Complete-case: Für Paired Tests (z.B. V1 vs A)
#   - Sensitivity: Vergleich Complete-case vs All-cases
#
# Literatur:
#   - Missing Data in Longitudinal Studies (PMC3016756)
#   - Single timepoint comparisons (BMC 2016)
#   - Mixed Model ITT Analysis (NCBI NBK538904)

sample_meta_clinical_complete <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  filter(
    pid %in% triplet_status$pid[triplet_status$complete_triplet],
    !is.na(age),
    !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)
  )

message("\n--- FINAL COMPLETE-CASE DATASET ---")
message("  Samples: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical_complete))
message("  Patients: ", n_distinct(sample_meta_clinical_complete$pid))
message("  Criteria: Complete triplets + age + GSVA scores")

saveRDS(sample_meta_clinical_complete,
        file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical_complete.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Kontinuierliche Variablen: Mean ± SD
clinical_describe_continuous <- function(data, var_name) {
  vec <- data[[var_name]]
  n_obs <- sum(!is.na(vec))
  if (n_obs == 0) {
    return(sprintf("N=0"))
  }
  m <- mean(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f (n=%d)", m, s, n_obs)
}

# Kategoriale Variablen: n (%)
clinical_describe_categorical <- function(data, var_name, level = NULL) {
  vec <- data[[var_name]]
  n_total <- sum(!is.na(vec))
  if (n_total == 0) {
    return(sprintf("0 (0%%)"))
  }
  if (is.null(level)) {
    # Falls kein Level: nimm erstes non-NA unique
    level <- unique(vec)[!is.na(unique(vec))][1]
  }
  n_level <- sum(vec == level, na.rm = TRUE)
  pct <- round(n_level / n_total * 100, 1)
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_level, pct)
}
```

# SCHRITT 9: Primary Analyses

**Ziel:** 3 Primary Research Questions mit vollständiger Dokumentation

**Analysen:**
1. Q1: EF_group × Inflammation (V1 vs A)
2. Q2: Relevant_CAD × Ribosome Recovery (V2 vs V1)
3. LQ2: Myeloid-Lymphoid-Shift

**Methode:** Linear Mixed Models (`lmerTest::lmer`)

**Pflicht-Checks:**
- VIF < 5
- Residuen-Diagnostik
- Zellenbesetzung (n≥15 pro Interaktionszelle)


```{r}
#| label: step9-primary-q1-ef-inflammation
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Helper: sichere Plot-Outputs (optional, falls nicht schon definiert)
if (!exists("safe_ggsave")) {
  safe_ggsave <- function(path = NULL, plot = NULL, width, height,
                          dpi = 300, bg = "white", filename = NULL, ...) {
    if (is.null(path)) path <- filename
    if (is.null(path)) stop("safe_ggsave: path/filename fehlt")
    tryCatch({
      ggsave(filename = path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height,
             dpi = dpi, bg = bg, ...)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("⚠️ ggsave fehlgeschlagen: ", conditionMessage(e))
      FALSE
    })
  }
}
if (!exists("safe_include_graphics")) {
  safe_include_graphics <- function(path) {
    if (file.exists(path)) {
      knitr::include_graphics(path)
    } else {
      message("⚠️ Grafik nicht gefunden: ", path)
      invisible(NULL)
    }
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Research Question Q1 (PRIMARY):
# Patienten mit reduzierter EF zeigen stärkere/veränderte akute
# Inflammationsantwort (V1 vs A) im Vergleich zu erhaltener EF
#
# Literatur-Basis: HFrEF = systemische Inflammation (Granger 2005)
# Hypothese: EF-Gruppe ist assoziiert mit Inflammations-Dynamik post-TAVI
# ============================================================

# Daten: Nur A + V1, nur Patienten mit EF_group und vollständigen Daten
clinical_data_q1 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ef_group), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  droplevels()

# ============================================================
# PRE-ANALYSIS: Zellenbesetzung (KRITISCH)
# ============================================================

clinical_cell_counts_q1 <- clinical_data_q1 %>%
  dplyr::count(timepoint, ef_group) %>%
  arrange(timepoint, ef_group)

clinical_min_cell_q1 <- min(clinical_cell_counts_q1$n)

if (clinical_min_cell_q1 < clinical_params$min_n_per_group) {
  clinical_q1_run_interaction <- FALSE
} else {
  clinical_q1_run_interaction <- TRUE
}

# ============================================================
# MODELL: Mixed-Effects mit Interaktion
# ============================================================

# Check: Cell-type Kovariaten verfügbar?
clinical_required_celltypes <- c("celltype_Monocytes","celltype_T_cells","celltype_Neutrophils")
clinical_available_celltypes <- clinical_required_celltypes[clinical_required_celltypes %in% names(clinical_data_q1)]
clinical_missing_celltypes <- setdiff(clinical_required_celltypes, clinical_available_celltypes)

if (length(clinical_missing_celltypes) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ Cell composition covariates missing – model run without cell adjustment")
  message("   Interpret results with caution (Confounder not adjusted)")
  clinical_use_celltypes <- FALSE
} else {
  clinical_use_celltypes <- TRUE
}

if (clinical_q1_run_interaction) {
  if (clinical_use_celltypes) {
    clinical_model_q1 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_group + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    clinical_model_q1 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_group + age + sex +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  }
} else {
  if (clinical_use_celltypes) {
    clinical_model_q1 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_group + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    clinical_model_q1 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_group + age + sex +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# VIF-Check (Kollinearität)
# ============================================================

clinical_vif_q1 <- car::vif(clinical_model_q1)

# ============================================================
# Koeffizienten-Extraktion
# ============================================================

clinical_coef_q1 <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_q1, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
  dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# VARIANZSTRUKTUR-TEST (Issue D.1)
# Vergleich: Compound Symmetry (lmer) vs Heterogene Varianz (nlme)
# ============================================================

message("\n--- VARIANCE STRUCTURE COMPARISON (Q1) ---")

# Baue vergleichbares nlme-Modell mit heterogener Varianz pro Zeitpunkt
suppressWarnings({
  if (clinical_q1_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes) {
    clinical_model_q1_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_group + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  } else if (clinical_q1_run_interaction && !clinical_use_celltypes) {
    clinical_model_q1_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_group + age + sex,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  } else if (!clinical_q1_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes) {
    clinical_model_q1_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_group + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  } else {
    clinical_model_q1_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_group + age + sex,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q1,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  }
})

# AIC/BIC Vergleich
clinical_aic_lmer <- AIC(clinical_model_q1)
clinical_aic_lme <- AIC(clinical_model_q1_lme)
clinical_bic_lmer <- BIC(clinical_model_q1)
clinical_bic_lme <- BIC(clinical_model_q1_lme)

message(sprintf("  lmer (Compound Symmetry):  AIC = %.1f, BIC = %.1f",
                clinical_aic_lmer, clinical_bic_lmer))
message(sprintf("  lme (Heterogeneous Var):   AIC = %.1f, BIC = %.1f",
                clinical_aic_lme, clinical_bic_lme))

if (clinical_aic_lme < clinical_aic_lmer - 2) {
  message("  → Heterogene Varianzstruktur bevorzugt (ΔAIC > 2)")
  clinical_q1_variance_note <- "Heterogeneous variance model preferred"
} else {
  message("  → Compound Symmetry ausreichend (kein substanzieller Unterschied)")
  clinical_q1_variance_note <- "Compound symmetry adequate"
}

# ============================================================
# CROSS-VALIDATION (Issue O.1/O.3)
# LOO-CV zur internen Validierung der Modellgeneralisierbarkeit
# ============================================================

message("\n--- CROSS-VALIDATION (Q1) ---")

# Erstelle Formel basierend auf Modellkonfiguration
if (clinical_q1_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes) {
  q1_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_group + age + sex + celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils + (1|pid)"
  )
} else if (clinical_q1_run_interaction && !clinical_use_celltypes) {
  q1_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_group + age + sex + (1|pid)"
  )
} else if (!clinical_q1_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes) {
  q1_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_group + age + sex + celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils + (1|pid)"
  )
} else {
  q1_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_group + age + sex + (1|pid)"
  )
}

clinical_q1_cv <- run_loocv(
  model_formula = q1_cv_formula,
  data = clinical_data_q1,
  model_type = "lmer",
  id_col = "pid"
)

message(sprintf("  LOPO (Leave-One-Patient-Out) R² = %.3f", clinical_q1_cv$r_squared))
message(sprintf("  LOPO RMSE = %.3f", clinical_q1_cv$rmse))
message(sprintf("  Valid predictions: %d/%d observations",
                clinical_q1_cv$n_valid, clinical_q1_cv$n_total))
message(sprintf("  Valid folds: %d/%d patients",
                clinical_q1_cv$n_folds_valid, clinical_q1_cv$n_folds_total))

# ============================================================
# Residuen-Diagnostik
# ============================================================

clinical_data_q1 <- clinical_data_q1 %>%
  mutate(
    resid_val = residuals(clinical_model_q1),
    fitted_val = fitted(clinical_model_q1)
  )

# Diagnostik-Plots direkt in Datei speichern (verhindert knitr wrapup recursion)
png(file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_q1_diagnostics.png"),
    width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(
  clinical_data_q1$fitted_val,
  clinical_data_q1$resid_val,
  xlab = "Fitted Values",
  ylab = "Residuals",
  main = "Q1: Residuals vs Fitted",
  pch = 16,
  col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2)
loess_fit <- tryCatch(
  loess(resid_val ~ fitted_val, data = clinical_data_q1),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (!is.null(loess_fit)) {
  lines(
    sort(clinical_data_q1$fitted_val),
    predict(loess_fit)[order(clinical_data_q1$fitted_val)],
    col = "blue",
    lwd = 2
  )
}
qqnorm(clinical_data_q1$resid_val, main = "Q1: Normal Q-Q Plot", pch = 16)
qqline(clinical_data_q1$resid_val, col = "red", lwd = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
invisible(dev.off())

# ============================================================
# Heteroskedastizitäts-Tests
# ============================================================

# Levene's Test: Varianz-Homogenität über Gruppen
# Null-Hypothese: Gleiche Varianz über alle Gruppen
clinical_levene_q1_timepoint <- car::leveneTest(
  resid_val ~ timepoint,
  data = clinical_data_q1
)

clinical_levene_q1_ef <- car::leveneTest(
  resid_val ~ ef_group,
  data = clinical_data_q1
)

# ============================================================
# Effect Size: Cohen's d (pro Gruppe)
# ============================================================

clinical_effect_q1 <- clinical_data_q1 %>%
  group_by(timepoint, ef_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(clinical_inflammation_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(clinical_inflammation_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Cohen's d für V1-A Delta pro EF-Gruppe
clinical_data_q1_wide <- clinical_data_q1 %>%
  dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, ef_group, clinical_inflammation_score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = clinical_inflammation_score) %>%
  mutate(delta_V1_A = V1 - A)

clinical_cohens_d_q1 <- clinical_data_q1_wide %>%
  group_by(ef_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_delta = mean(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_delta = sd(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Within-subject Cohen's d (d_z):
    # d_z = mean(difference) / SD(difference)
    # Geeignet für repeated measures / paired designs
    # (SD der Differenzen berücksichtigt implizit within-subject Korrelation)
    cohens_d = ifelse(sd_delta > 0, mean_delta / sd_delta, NA_real_)
  )

# ============================================================
# Visualisierung: Interaction Plot
# ============================================================

clinical_plot_q1 <- clinical_effect_q1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = mean, color = ef_group, group = ef_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PRIMARY Q1: EF Group × Inflammation Response",
    subtitle = sprintf("Interaction Model (n=%d patients)", n_distinct(clinical_data_q1$pid)),
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Inflammation Score (GSVA Composite)",
    color = "EF Group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Plot direkt in Datei speichern (nicht via knitr rendern)
safe_ggsave(
  file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_q1_ef_inflammation.png"),
  clinical_plot_q1,
  width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# ============================================================
# Speichere Ergebnisse (ohne Plot-Objekte)
# ============================================================

clinical_results_q1 <- list(
  model = clinical_model_q1,
  coefficients = clinical_coef_q1,
  vif = clinical_vif_q1,
  effect_sizes = clinical_effect_q1,
  cohens_d = clinical_cohens_d_q1,
  cell_counts = clinical_cell_counts_q1,
  cv = clinical_q1_cv,
  variance_note = clinical_q1_variance_note
)

saveRDS(clinical_results_q1, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "primary_q1_results.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: step9-primary-q2-cad-ribosome
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ============================================================
# Research Question Q2 (PRIMARY):
# Patienten mit signifikanter CAD zeigen veränderte ribosomale
# Recovery (V2 vs V1) im Vergleich zu Patienten ohne CAD
#
# Literatur-Basis: Ischämie → Proteinsynthese-Stress (Kimball 2002)
# Hypothese: CAD ist assoziiert mit Ribosomen-Recovery-Kinetik
# Kernfinding: Biphasische Ribosomen-Signatur (RESULTS_STORY.md)
# ============================================================

# Daten: Nur V1 + V2 (Recovery-Phase), nur mit CAD-Status
clinical_data_q2 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("V1", "V2")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relevant_cad), !is.na(clinical_ribosome_score)) %>%
  droplevels()

# ============================================================
# PRE-ANALYSIS: Zellenbesetzung
# ============================================================

clinical_cell_counts_q2 <- clinical_data_q2 %>%
  dplyr::count(timepoint, relevant_cad) %>%
  arrange(timepoint, relevant_cad)

clinical_min_cell_q2 <- min(clinical_cell_counts_q2$n)

if (clinical_min_cell_q2 < clinical_params$min_n_per_group) {
  clinical_q2_run_interaction <- FALSE
} else {
  clinical_q2_run_interaction <- TRUE
}

# ============================================================
# MODELL: Mixed-Effects mit Interaktion
# ============================================================

# Check: Cell-type Kovariaten verfügbar?
clinical_available_celltypes_q2 <- clinical_required_celltypes[clinical_required_celltypes %in% names(clinical_data_q2)]
clinical_missing_celltypes_q2 <- setdiff(clinical_required_celltypes, clinical_available_celltypes_q2)

if (length(clinical_missing_celltypes_q2) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ Cell composition covariates missing – model run without cell adjustment")
  message("   Interpret results with caution (Confounder C.2 not adjusted)")
  clinical_use_celltypes_q2 <- FALSE
} else {
  clinical_use_celltypes_q2 <- TRUE
}

if (clinical_q2_run_interaction) {
  if (clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
    clinical_model_q2 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint * relevant_cad + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    clinical_model_q2 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint * relevant_cad + age + sex +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  }
} else {
  if (clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
    clinical_model_q2 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint + relevant_cad + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    clinical_model_q2 <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint + relevant_cad + age + sex +
        (1 | pid),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# VIF-Check
# ============================================================

clinical_vif_q2 <- car::vif(clinical_model_q2)

# ============================================================
# Koeffizienten
# ============================================================

clinical_coef_q2 <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_q2, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
  dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# VARIANZSTRUKTUR-TEST (Issue D.1)
# Vergleich: Compound Symmetry (lmer) vs Heterogene Varianz (nlme)
# ============================================================

message("\n--- VARIANCE STRUCTURE COMPARISON (Q2) ---")

# Baue vergleichbares nlme-Modell mit heterogener Varianz pro Zeitpunkt
suppressWarnings({
  if (clinical_q2_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
    clinical_model_q2_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint * relevant_cad + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  } else if (clinical_q2_run_interaction && !clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
    clinical_model_q2_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint * relevant_cad + age + sex,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  } else if (!clinical_q2_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
    clinical_model_q2_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint + relevant_cad + age + sex +
        celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  } else {
    clinical_model_q2_lme <- nlme::lme(
      clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint + relevant_cad + age + sex,
      random = ~ 1 | pid,
      weights = nlme::varIdent(form = ~ 1 | timepoint),
      data = clinical_data_q2,
      method = "REML",
      control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 100, msMaxIter = 100)
    )
  }
})

# AIC/BIC Vergleich
clinical_aic_lmer_q2 <- AIC(clinical_model_q2)
clinical_aic_lme_q2 <- AIC(clinical_model_q2_lme)
clinical_bic_lmer_q2 <- BIC(clinical_model_q2)
clinical_bic_lme_q2 <- BIC(clinical_model_q2_lme)

message(sprintf("  lmer (Compound Symmetry):  AIC = %.1f, BIC = %.1f",
                clinical_aic_lmer_q2, clinical_bic_lmer_q2))
message(sprintf("  lme (Heterogeneous Var):   AIC = %.1f, BIC = %.1f",
                clinical_aic_lme_q2, clinical_bic_lme_q2))

if (clinical_aic_lme_q2 < clinical_aic_lmer_q2 - 2) {
  message("  → Heterogene Varianzstruktur bevorzugt (ΔAIC > 2)")
  clinical_q2_variance_note <- "Heterogeneous variance model preferred"
} else {
  message("  → Compound Symmetry ausreichend (kein substanzieller Unterschied)")
  clinical_q2_variance_note <- "Compound symmetry adequate"
}

# ============================================================
# CROSS-VALIDATION (Issue O.1/O.3)
# LOO-CV zur internen Validierung der Modellgeneralisierbarkeit
# ============================================================

message("\n--- CROSS-VALIDATION (Q2) ---")

# Erstelle Formel basierend auf Modellkonfiguration
if (clinical_q2_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
  q2_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint * relevant_cad + age + sex + celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils + (1|pid)"
  )
} else if (clinical_q2_run_interaction && !clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
  q2_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint * relevant_cad + age + sex + (1|pid)"
  )
} else if (!clinical_q2_run_interaction && clinical_use_celltypes_q2) {
  q2_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint + relevant_cad + age + sex + celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils + (1|pid)"
  )
} else {
  q2_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_ribosome_score ~ timepoint + relevant_cad + age + sex + (1|pid)"
  )
}

clinical_q2_cv <- run_loocv(
  model_formula = q2_cv_formula,
  data = clinical_data_q2,
  model_type = "lmer",
  id_col = "pid"
)

message(sprintf("  LOPO (Leave-One-Patient-Out) R² = %.3f", clinical_q2_cv$r_squared))
message(sprintf("  LOPO RMSE = %.3f", clinical_q2_cv$rmse))
message(sprintf("  Valid predictions: %d/%d observations",
                clinical_q2_cv$n_valid, clinical_q2_cv$n_total))
message(sprintf("  Valid folds: %d/%d patients",
                clinical_q2_cv$n_folds_valid, clinical_q2_cv$n_folds_total))

# ============================================================
# Residuen-Diagnostik
# ============================================================

clinical_data_q2 <- clinical_data_q2 %>%
  mutate(
    resid_val = residuals(clinical_model_q2),
    fitted_val = fitted(clinical_model_q2)
  )

# Diagnostik-Plots direkt in Datei speichern (verhindert knitr wrapup recursion)
png(file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_q2_diagnostics.png"),
    width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(
  clinical_data_q2$fitted_val,
  clinical_data_q2$resid_val,
  xlab = "Fitted Values",
  ylab = "Residuals",
  main = "Q2: Residuals vs Fitted",
  pch = 16,
  col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2)
loess_fit_q2 <- tryCatch(
  loess(resid_val ~ fitted_val, data = clinical_data_q2),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (!is.null(loess_fit_q2)) {
  lines(
    sort(clinical_data_q2$fitted_val),
    predict(loess_fit_q2)[order(clinical_data_q2$fitted_val)],
    col = "blue",
    lwd = 2
  )
}
qqnorm(clinical_data_q2$resid_val, main = "Q2: Normal Q-Q Plot", pch = 16)
qqline(clinical_data_q2$resid_val, col = "red", lwd = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
invisible(dev.off())

# ============================================================
# Heteroskedastizitäts-Tests
# ============================================================

clinical_levene_q2_timepoint <- car::leveneTest(
  resid_val ~ timepoint,
  data = clinical_data_q2
)

clinical_levene_q2_cad <- car::leveneTest(
  resid_val ~ relevant_cad,
  data = clinical_data_q2
)

# ============================================================
# Effect Size
# ============================================================

clinical_effect_q2 <- clinical_data_q2 %>%
  group_by(timepoint, relevant_cad) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(clinical_ribosome_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(clinical_ribosome_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Cohen's d für V2-V1 Recovery Delta pro CAD-Gruppe
clinical_data_q2_wide <- clinical_data_q2 %>%
  dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, relevant_cad, clinical_ribosome_score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = clinical_ribosome_score) %>%
  mutate(delta_V2_V1 = V2 - V1)

clinical_cohens_d_q2 <- clinical_data_q2_wide %>%
  group_by(relevant_cad) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_delta = mean(delta_V2_V1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_delta = sd(delta_V2_V1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cohens_d = ifelse(sd_delta > 0, mean_delta / sd_delta, NA_real_),
    cad_label = ifelse(relevant_cad, "CAD", "No CAD")
  )

# ============================================================
# Visualisierung
# ============================================================

clinical_plot_q2 <- clinical_effect_q2 %>%
  mutate(cad_label = ifelse(relevant_cad, "CAD", "No CAD")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = mean, color = cad_label, group = cad_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PRIMARY Q2: CAD × Ribosome Recovery",
    subtitle = sprintf("Interaction Model (n=%d patients)", n_distinct(clinical_data_q2$pid)),
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Ribosome Score (GSVA Composite)",
    color = "CAD Status"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Plot direkt in Datei speichern (nicht via knitr rendern)
safe_ggsave(
  file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_q2_cad_ribosome.png"),
  clinical_plot_q2,
  width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# ============================================================
# Speichere Ergebnisse (ohne Plot-Objekte)
# ============================================================

clinical_results_q2 <- list(
  model = clinical_model_q2,
  coefficients = clinical_coef_q2,
  vif = clinical_vif_q2,
  effect_sizes = clinical_effect_q2,
  cohens_d = clinical_cohens_d_q2,
  cell_counts = clinical_cell_counts_q2,
  cv = clinical_q2_cv,
  variance_note = clinical_q2_variance_note
)

saveRDS(clinical_results_q2, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "primary_q2_results.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: step9-primary-lq2-myeloid-lymphoid-shift
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# ============================================================
# Research Question LQ2 (PRIMARY):
# TAVI induziert biphasische Myeloid-Lymphoid-Dynamik:
# - V1 (akut): Myeloid ↑, Lymphoid ↓
# - V2 (Recovery): Rebalancierung / Reversion
#
# Literatur-Basis: Kuppe et al. 2024 (STEMI scRNA-seq)
# - Monozyten ↑, NK-Zellen ↓ in akuter Phase
# - Lymphoid Recovery nach Wochen
# Novelty: Erste Anwendung auf TAVI-Kohorte (Bulk RNA-seq)
# ============================================================

message("\n⏳ Prüfe Deconvolution-Verfügbarkeit...")

# Prüfe ob Deconvolution-Scores verfügbar sind
clinical_has_deconv <- "celltype_Monocytes" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete)

# Prüfe Plausibilität (Flag aus Step 5)
if (!exists("clinical_monocyte_plausible")) {
  clinical_monocyte_plausible <- NA  # Falls Step 5 übersprungen
}

if (!clinical_has_deconv) {
  message("⚠️ Deconvolution-Scores NICHT verfügbar")
  message("   → LQ2 wird mit Pathway-basierten Surrogaten analysiert")
  message("   → Limitation: Keine direkte Zelltyp-Quantifikation")
  clinical_lq2_mode <- "pathway"

} else if (isFALSE(clinical_monocyte_plausible)) {
  message("⚠️ Deconvolution-Scores verfügbar, ABER Plausibilitätsprüfung FEHLGESCHLAGEN")
  message("   → Monozyten-Dynamik nicht konsistent mit Literatur (Kuppe 2024)")
  message("   → LQ2 wird mit Pathway-basierten Surrogaten analysiert (konservativer Ansatz)")
  message("   → Limitation wird in Manuskript dokumentiert")
  clinical_lq2_mode <- "pathway"

} else {
  message("✓ Deconvolution-Scores verfügbar und plausibel (MCP-counter)")
  message("   → LQ2 wird mit direkten Zelltyp-Scores analysiert")
  clinical_lq2_mode <- "deconvolution"
}

# ============================================================
# Robust: Zelltyp-Spalten harmonisieren & validieren
# ============================================================

# NK-Name vereinheitlichen (verhindert select-Fehler bei NK_cell vs NK_cells)
if ("celltype_NK_cell" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete) &&
    !"celltype_NK_cells" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete)) {
  sample_meta_clinical_complete$celltype_NK_cells <- sample_meta_clinical_complete$celltype_NK_cell
}
if ("celltype_NK_cells" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete) &&
    !"celltype_NK_cell" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete)) {
  sample_meta_clinical_complete$celltype_NK_cell <- sample_meta_clinical_complete$celltype_NK_cells
}

clinical_required_celltypes <- c("celltype_Monocytes", "celltype_T_cells", "celltype_Neutrophils")
clinical_missing_celltypes <- setdiff(clinical_required_celltypes, names(sample_meta_clinical_complete))
if (length(clinical_missing_celltypes) > 0) {
  stop("❌ Fehlende Zelltyp-Spalten: ", paste(clinical_missing_celltypes, collapse = ", "))
}

# ============================================================
# MODUS 1: Deconvolution-basiert (bevorzugt)
# ============================================================

if (clinical_lq2_mode == "deconvolution") {

  # NK-Zell-Spalte robust detektieren (MCP-counter variiert: NK_cell vs NK_cells)
  clinical_nk_col <- intersect(
    c("celltype_NK_cells", "celltype_NK_cell"),
    names(sample_meta_clinical_complete)
  )
  clinical_has_nk <- length(clinical_nk_col) > 0
  if (!clinical_has_nk) {
    message("  ⚠️ Keine NK-Zell-Spalte gefunden — MLR wird ohne NK-Zellen berechnet")
  } else {
    clinical_nk_col <- clinical_nk_col[1]
    message("  ✓ NK-Zell-Spalte: ", clinical_nk_col)
  }

  # Daten: Alle 3 Zeitpunkte — Kern-Selektion
  clinical_data_lq2 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
    filter(!is.na(celltype_Monocytes), !is.na(celltype_T_cells)) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_id, pid, timepoint, age, sex,
      clinical_mono = celltype_Monocytes,
      clinical_tcells = celltype_T_cells,
      clinical_neutro = celltype_Neutrophils
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  # NK-Zellen hinzufügen (falls verfügbar, sonst 0)
  if (clinical_has_nk) {
    clinical_data_lq2$clinical_nk <- sample_meta_clinical_complete[[clinical_nk_col]][
      match(clinical_data_lq2$sample_id, sample_meta_clinical_complete$sample_id)
    ]
  } else {
    clinical_data_lq2$clinical_nk <- 0
  }

  # MLR berechnen (Log-Ratio, Standard für compositional data; Aitchison, 1986)
  clinical_data_lq2 <- clinical_data_lq2 %>%
    mutate(
      clinical_myeloid_sum = clinical_mono + clinical_neutro + 0.01,
      clinical_lymphoid_sum = clinical_tcells + clinical_nk + 0.01,
      clinical_mlr = log2(clinical_myeloid_sum / clinical_lymphoid_sum)
    )

  message("✓ LQ2 Dataset: ", nrow(clinical_data_lq2), " samples from ",
          n_distinct(clinical_data_lq2$pid), " patients")

  # ============================================================
  # MODELL: Monozyten über Zeit
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⏳ Analysiere Monozyten-Dynamik...")

  clinical_model_lq2_mono <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_mono ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_mono <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_mono, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value)

  message("\n--- MONOCYTES: Coefficients ---")
  safe_print(clinical_coef_lq2_mono)

  # ============================================================
  # MODELL: T-Zellen über Zeit
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⏳ Analysiere T-Zell-Dynamik...")

  clinical_model_lq2_tcells <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_tcells ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_tcells <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_tcells, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value)

  message("\n--- T-CELLS: Coefficients ---")
  safe_print(clinical_coef_lq2_tcells)

  # ============================================================
  # MODELL: Myeloid-Lymphoid-Ratio
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⏳ Analysiere Myeloid-Lymphoid-Ratio...")

  clinical_model_lq2_mlr <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_mlr ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_mlr <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_mlr, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, df, p.value)

  message("\n--- MYELOID-LYMPHOID-RATIO: Coefficients ---")
  safe_print(clinical_coef_lq2_mlr)

  # ============================================================
  # CROSS-VALIDATION (Issue O.1/O.3) - MLR als Haupt-Outcome
  # ============================================================

  message("\n--- CROSS-VALIDATION (LQ2 MLR) ---")

  lq2_mlr_cv_formula <- as.formula(
    "clinical_mlr ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1|pid)"
  )

  clinical_lq2_cv <- run_loocv(
    model_formula = lq2_mlr_cv_formula,
    data = clinical_data_lq2,
    model_type = "lmer",
    id_col = "pid"
  )

  message(sprintf("  LOPO (Leave-One-Patient-Out) R² = %.3f", clinical_lq2_cv$r_squared))
  message(sprintf("  LOPO RMSE = %.3f", clinical_lq2_cv$rmse))
  message(sprintf("  Valid predictions: %d/%d observations",
                  clinical_lq2_cv$n_valid, clinical_lq2_cv$n_total))
  message(sprintf("  Valid folds: %d/%d patients",
                  clinical_lq2_cv$n_folds_valid, clinical_lq2_cv$n_folds_total))

  # ============================================================
  # Effect Sizes
  # ============================================================

  clinical_effect_lq2 <- clinical_data_lq2 %>%
    group_by(timepoint) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mono_mean = mean(clinical_mono, na.rm = TRUE),
      mono_sd = sd(clinical_mono, na.rm = TRUE),
      tcells_mean = mean(clinical_tcells, na.rm = TRUE),
      tcells_sd = sd(clinical_tcells, na.rm = TRUE),
      mlr_mean = mean(clinical_mlr, na.rm = TRUE),
      mlr_sd = sd(clinical_mlr, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()  # Sichere Konvertierung zu data.frame

  message("\n--- EFFECT SIZES LQ2 ---")
  safe_print(clinical_effect_lq2, row.names = FALSE)

  # ============================================================
  # Visualisierung: Multi-Panel (Mono, T-cells, MLR)
  # ============================================================

  message("⏳ Erstelle Visualisierungen...")

  # Timepoint-Faktor korrekt ordnen
  clinical_data_lq2$timepoint <- factor(clinical_data_lq2$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

  # Einzelpanels erstellen
  clinical_plot_lq2_a <- ggplot(clinical_data_lq2, aes(x = timepoint, y = clinical_mono)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = timepoint), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "red") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "A: Monocyte Dynamics", x = "Timepoint", y = "Monocyte Score (MCP-counter)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  clinical_plot_lq2_b <- ggplot(clinical_data_lq2, aes(x = timepoint, y = clinical_tcells)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = timepoint), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "blue") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "B: T-Cell Dynamics", x = "Timepoint", y = "T-Cell Score (MCP-counter)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  clinical_plot_lq2_c <- ggplot(clinical_data_lq2, aes(x = timepoint, y = clinical_mlr)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = timepoint), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "purple") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "purple", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "C: Myeloid-Lymphoid Ratio", x = "Timepoint", y = "log2(Myeloid / Lymphoid)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  # ============================================================
  # Plots in Dateien speichern (nicht via knitr rendern)
  # ============================================================

  message("  Saving plots...")

  safe_ggsave(
    file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_lq2_monocytes.png"),
    plot = clinical_plot_lq2_a,
    width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )

  safe_ggsave(
    file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_lq2_tcells.png"),
    plot = clinical_plot_lq2_b,
    width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )

  safe_ggsave(
    file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_lq2_mlr.png"),
    plot = clinical_plot_lq2_c,
    width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )

  # Kombinierter Plot: direkt in PNG-Device rendern
  clinical_lq2_combined_path <- file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "primary_lq2_combined.png")
  combined_ok <- tryCatch({
    png(clinical_lq2_combined_path, width = 10, height = 14, units = "in", res = 300)
    print(
      clinical_plot_lq2_a / clinical_plot_lq2_b / clinical_plot_lq2_c +
        plot_annotation(
          title = "PRIMARY LQ2: Myeloid-Lymphoid Shift nach TAVI",
          subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_distinct(clinical_data_lq2$pid),
                            " Patienten, 3 Zeitpunkte (A, V1, V2)"),
          caption = "MCP-counter Deconvolution | lmer(Score ~ timepoint + age + sex + (1|pid))"
        )
    )
    dev.off()
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("⚠️ Kombinierter LQ2-Plot fehlgeschlagen: ", conditionMessage(e))
    if (dev.cur() > 1) dev.off()
    FALSE
  })

  message("  ✓ Plots gespeichert in: ", clinical_fig_dir)

  # Saved Plots im Quarto-Dokument anzeigen
  if (isTRUE(combined_ok)) {
    message("ℹ️ Kombinierter LQ2-Plot gespeichert (nicht eingebettet): ", clinical_lq2_combined_path)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Speichere Ergebnisse (ohne Plot-Objekte)
  # ============================================================

  clinical_results_lq2 <- list(
    mode = "deconvolution",
    model_monocytes = clinical_model_lq2_mono,
    model_tcells = clinical_model_lq2_tcells,
    model_mlr = clinical_model_lq2_mlr,
    coef_monocytes = clinical_coef_lq2_mono,
    coef_tcells = clinical_coef_lq2_tcells,
    coef_mlr = clinical_coef_lq2_mlr,
    effect_sizes = clinical_effect_lq2,
    cv = clinical_lq2_cv
  )

  saveRDS(clinical_results_lq2, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "primary_lq2_results.rds"))
  message("💾 Ergebnisse gespeichert: primary_lq2_results.rds")

} else {

  # ============================================================
  # MODUS 2: Pathway-basiert (Fallback)
  # ============================================================

  message("\n⚠️ LQ2 FALLBACK: Pathway-basierte Analyse")
  message("   → Nutze GSVA-Scores als Surrogate für Zelltyp-Aktivität")

  # Nutze Inflammation (Myeloid-Proxy) und Adaptive (Lymphoid-Proxy)
  clinical_data_lq2_pathway <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
    filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score), !is.na(clinical_adaptive_score)) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_id, pid, timepoint, age, sex,
      clinical_myeloid_proxy = clinical_inflammation_score,
      clinical_lymphoid_proxy = clinical_adaptive_score,
      celltype_Monocytes, celltype_T_cells, celltype_Neutrophils
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      clinical_mlr_proxy = clinical_myeloid_proxy - clinical_lymphoid_proxy
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  message("✓ LQ2 Pathway Dataset: ", nrow(clinical_data_lq2_pathway), " samples")

  # Modell: Myeloid-Proxy
  clinical_model_lq2_myeloid <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_myeloid_proxy ~ timepoint + age + sex +
      celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils +
      (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2_pathway,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_myeloid, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed")

  message("\n--- MYELOID-PROXY (Inflammation): Coefficients ---")
  safe_print(clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid)

  # Modell: Lymphoid-Proxy
  clinical_model_lq2_lymphoid <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_lymphoid_proxy ~ timepoint + age + sex +
      celltype_Monocytes + celltype_T_cells + celltype_Neutrophils +
      (1 | pid),
    data = clinical_data_lq2_pathway,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  clinical_coef_lq2_lymphoid <- broom.mixed::tidy(clinical_model_lq2_lymphoid, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed")

  message("\n--- LYMPHOID-PROXY (Adaptive): Coefficients ---")
  safe_print(clinical_coef_lq2_lymphoid)

  clinical_results_lq2 <- list(
    mode = "pathway",
    model_myeloid = clinical_model_lq2_myeloid,
    model_lymphoid = clinical_model_lq2_lymphoid,
    coef_myeloid = clinical_coef_lq2_myeloid,
    coef_lymphoid = clinical_coef_lq2_lymphoid
  )

  saveRDS(clinical_results_lq2, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "primary_lq2_results.rds"))
  message("💾 Ergebnisse gespeichert (Pathway-Modus): primary_lq2_results.rds")
}

message("\n✓ PRIMARY LQ2 abgeschlossen (Modus: ", clinical_lq2_mode, ")")
```

```{r}
#| label: step9-primary-summary-multiple-testing
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("=== SCHRITT 9.4: PRIMARY SUMMARY & Multiple Testing Correction ===")

# ============================================================
# Ziel: Konsolidiere alle Primary Results, appliziere Holm-Bonferroni
# Entscheidung E4: Holm-Korrektur für 3 Primary-Tests
# ============================================================

message("\n⏳ Konsolidiere Primary Results...")

# ============================================================
# Extrahiere KEY P-VALUES aus allen 3 Primary Analyses
# Methode: Nutze anova() für robuste Effekt-Tests (Type III)
# ============================================================

# Q1: Interaktion timepoint × EF_group (oder Haupteffekt falls nicht gefittet)
if (exists("clinical_model_q1")) {
  clinical_anova_q1 <- anova(clinical_model_q1, type = "III")

  # Prüfe ob Interaktion im Modell vorhanden
  if ("timepoint:ef_group" %in% rownames(clinical_anova_q1)) {
    clinical_pval_q1 <- clinical_anova_q1["timepoint:ef_group", "Pr(>F)"]
    message("  Q1: Interaktion timepoint:ef_group p = ",
            format.pval(clinical_pval_q1, digits = 3))
  } else {
    # Falls keine Interaktion: nimm Haupteffekt timepoint
    clinical_pval_q1 <- clinical_anova_q1["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]
    message("  Q1: Haupteffekt timepoint p = ",
            format.pval(clinical_pval_q1, digits = 3))
  }
} else {
  clinical_pval_q1 <- NA
  message("  Q1: Modell nicht vorhanden")
}

# Q2: Interaktion timepoint × relevant_cad (oder Haupteffekt)
if (exists("clinical_model_q2")) {
  clinical_anova_q2 <- anova(clinical_model_q2, type = "III")

  if ("timepoint:relevant_cad" %in% rownames(clinical_anova_q2)) {
    clinical_pval_q2 <- clinical_anova_q2["timepoint:relevant_cad", "Pr(>F)"]
    message("  Q2: Interaktion timepoint:relevant_cad p = ",
            format.pval(clinical_pval_q2, digits = 3))
  } else {
    clinical_pval_q2 <- clinical_anova_q2["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]
    message("  Q2: Haupteffekt timepoint p = ",
            format.pval(clinical_pval_q2, digits = 3))
  }
} else {
  clinical_pval_q2 <- NA
  message("  Q2: Modell nicht vorhanden")
}

# LQ2: Timepoint-Effekt (primär MLR, sonst Monozyten- oder Proxy-Modell)
if (exists("clinical_model_lq2_mlr")) {
  clinical_anova_lq2 <- anova(clinical_model_lq2_mlr, type = "III")
  clinical_pval_lq2 <- clinical_anova_lq2["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]
  message("  LQ2: Timepoint-Effekt (MLR) p = ",
          format.pval(clinical_pval_lq2, digits = 3))
} else if (exists("clinical_model_lq2_mono")) {
  clinical_anova_lq2 <- anova(clinical_model_lq2_mono, type = "III")
  clinical_pval_lq2 <- clinical_anova_lq2["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]
  message("  LQ2: Timepoint-Effekt (Monozyten) p = ",
          format.pval(clinical_pval_lq2, digits = 3))
} else if (exists("clinical_model_lq2_myeloid")) {
  clinical_anova_lq2 <- anova(clinical_model_lq2_myeloid, type = "III")
  clinical_pval_lq2 <- clinical_anova_lq2["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]
  message("  LQ2: Timepoint-Effekt (Myeloid-Proxy) p = ",
          format.pval(clinical_pval_lq2, digits = 3))
} else {
  clinical_pval_lq2 <- NA
  message("  LQ2: Modell nicht vorhanden")
}

# ============================================================
# Multiple Testing Correction: Holm-Bonferroni
# ============================================================

clinical_primary_pvalues <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c("Q1_EF_Inflammation", "Q2_CAD_Ribosome", "LQ2_Myeloid_Lymphoid"),
  Description = c(
    "EF group × Inflammation (V1 vs A)",
    "CAD × Ribosome Recovery (V2 vs V1)",
    "Myeloid-Lymphoid Shift (temporal dynamics)"
  ),
  raw_p = c(clinical_pval_q1, clinical_pval_q2, clinical_pval_lq2),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Holm-Korrektur
clinical_primary_pvalues <- clinical_primary_pvalues %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_p)) %>%
  mutate(
    holm_p = p.adjust(raw_p, method = "holm"),
    sig_raw = case_when(
      raw_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      raw_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      raw_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    sig_holm = case_when(
      holm_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      holm_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      holm_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

message("\n=== PRIMARY ANALYSES: Multiple Testing Correction (Holm) ===")
safe_print(clinical_primary_pvalues, row.names = FALSE)

# Speichere Summary
write.csv(
  clinical_primary_pvalues,
  file.path(clinical_output_dir, "primary_analyses_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("\n💾 Summary gespeichert: primary_analyses_summary.csv")

# ============================================================
# Interpretation Guide
# ============================================================

message("\n=== INTERPRETATION ===")
message("1. RAW P-VALUES: Unadjusted für multiple comparisons")
message("2. HOLM P-VALUES: Adjustiert für 3 Primary-Tests (konservativ)")
message("3. Berichte BEIDE in Paper:")
message("   - Main Text: Holm-adjusted")
message("   - Supplement: Raw p-values mit Disclosure")

n_sig_raw <- sum(clinical_primary_pvalues$raw_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig_holm <- sum(clinical_primary_pvalues$holm_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

message(sprintf(
  "\n✓ SIGNIFIKANTE BEFUNDE: %d/%d (raw), %d/%d (Holm-adjusted)",
  n_sig_raw, nrow(clinical_primary_pvalues),
  n_sig_holm, nrow(clinical_primary_pvalues)
))

message("\n✓ PRIMARY ANALYSES KOMPLETT")
```

```{r}
#| label: step10-helper-result-extraction
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n=== SCHRITT 10.1: Helper Functions for Result Extraction ===")

# ============================================================
# Central Helper: Extract standardized results from lm/lmer models
# Purpose: Avoid code duplication, ensure consistent reporting
# ============================================================

extract_model_results <- function(model, term_of_interest = NULL, model_name = "Model") {
  # Extract coefficients with CIs
  coef_table <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)

  # Filter for fixed effects (only for mixed models)
  if ("effect" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    coef_table <- coef_table %>%
      filter(effect == "fixed")
  }

  # Select relevant columns (handle missing 'df' column in some models)
  available_cols <- intersect(
    c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "conf.low", "conf.high", "statistic", "df", "p.value"),
    names(coef_table)
  )
  coef_table <- coef_table %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(available_cols))

  # If specific term requested, filter
  if (!is.null(term_of_interest)) {
    coef_table <- coef_table %>%
      filter(grepl(term_of_interest, term, fixed = FALSE))
  }

  # Add model diagnostics
  n_obs <- nobs(model)

  # VIF if multiple predictors
  vif_vals <- tryCatch(car::vif(model), error = function(e) NULL)

  # Return list with all relevant info
  list(
    coefficients = coef_table,
    n = n_obs,
    vif = vif_vals,
    model_name = model_name
  )
}

# ============================================================
# LOPO Cross-Validation for Model Validation (Issue O.1/O.3)
# Leave-One-Patient-Out CV: Robuste interne Validierung
# Purpose: Echte Generalisierung auf neue Patienten testen
# ============================================================

run_loocv <- function(model_formula, data, model_type = "lmer", id_col = "pid") {
  # Leave-One-Patient-Out Cross-Validation (LOPO)
  # Pro Fold: Ein Patient (alle Zeitpunkte) als Testset
  # Prediction: Fixed effects only (keine patient-spezifischen Random Effects)
  # Returns: RMSE, R², n_valid, n_total, pred_df

  # Extract response variable name from formula
  response_var <- as.character(model_formula)[2]

  # Check if id_col exists
  if (!id_col %in% names(data)) {
    stop(sprintf("id_col '%s' nicht in data gefunden", id_col))
  }

  # Unique patients
  unique_patients <- unique(data[[id_col]])
  n_patients <- length(unique_patients)

  message(sprintf("  Starting LOPO CV: %d patients, %d observations",
                  n_patients, nrow(data)))

  # Initialize storage for predictions
  all_predictions <- data.frame(
    pid = character(),
    row_id = integer(),
    y_true = numeric(),
    y_pred = numeric(),
    fold_id = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  n_folds_valid <- 0
  n_folds_failed <- 0

  # LOPO loop: iterate over patients
  for (fold_idx in seq_along(unique_patients)) {
    patient_id <- unique_patients[fold_idx]

    # Training data: all patients except current one
    train_data <- data[data[[id_col]] != patient_id, ]
    test_data <- data[data[[id_col]] == patient_id, ]

    # Skip if test set is empty
    if (nrow(test_data) == 0) {
      message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Testdaten leer, übersprungen",
                      fold_idx, patient_id))
      n_folds_failed <- n_folds_failed + 1
      next
    }

    # Fit model on training data
    fit_success <- FALSE
    fit_model <- NULL

    if (model_type == "lmer") {
      suppressWarnings({
        tryCatch({
          fit_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
            model_formula,
            data = train_data,
            REML = TRUE,
            control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)
          )
          fit_success <- TRUE
        }, error = function(e) {
          message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Modell-Fit fehlgeschlagen - %s",
                          fold_idx, patient_id, conditionMessage(e)))
        })
      })
    } else if (model_type == "lm") {
      suppressWarnings({
        tryCatch({
          fit_model <- lm(model_formula, data = train_data)
          fit_success <- TRUE
        }, error = function(e) {
          message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Modell-Fit fehlgeschlagen - %s",
                          fold_idx, patient_id, conditionMessage(e)))
        })
      })
    }

    if (!fit_success || is.null(fit_model)) {
      n_folds_failed <- n_folds_failed + 1
      next
    }

    # Predict on test data (fixed effects only for lmer)
    predictions <- NULL
    suppressWarnings({
      tryCatch({
        if (model_type == "lmer") {
          # Fixed effects only: re.form = NA
          predictions <- predict(
            fit_model,
            newdata = test_data,
            re.form = NA,  # Keine Random Effects
            allow.new.levels = TRUE
          )
        } else if (model_type == "lm") {
          predictions <- predict(fit_model, newdata = test_data)
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Prediction fehlgeschlagen - %s",
                        fold_idx, patient_id, conditionMessage(e)))
      })
    })

    # Check if predictions succeeded
    if (is.null(predictions) || any(is.na(predictions))) {
      message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): NA predictions, übersprungen",
                      fold_idx, patient_id))
      n_folds_failed <- n_folds_failed + 1
      next
    }

    # Extract true values
    actuals <- test_data[[response_var]]

    # Store predictions
    fold_predictions <- data.frame(
      pid = as.character(patient_id),
      row_id = which(data[[id_col]] == patient_id),
      y_true = actuals,
      y_pred = predictions,
      fold_id = fold_idx,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    all_predictions <- rbind(all_predictions, fold_predictions)
    n_folds_valid <- n_folds_valid + 1
  }

  # Calculate metrics from all collected predictions
  if (nrow(all_predictions) == 0) {
    message("  ❌ LOPO CV fehlgeschlagen: Keine gültigen Vorhersagen")
    return(list(
      rmse = NA,
      r_squared = NA,
      n_valid = 0,
      n_total = nrow(data),
      n_folds_valid = 0,
      n_folds_total = n_patients,
      pred_df = all_predictions
    ))
  }

  # RMSE
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((all_predictions$y_true - all_predictions$y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

  # R² out-of-sample
  ss_res <- sum((all_predictions$y_true - all_predictions$y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((all_predictions$y_true - mean(all_predictions$y_true, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

  # Return results
  list(
    rmse = rmse,
    r_squared = r_squared,
    n_valid = nrow(all_predictions),
    n_total = nrow(data),
    n_folds_valid = n_folds_valid,
    n_folds_total = n_patients,
    pred_df = all_predictions
  )
}

message("✓ Helper function extract_model_results() defined")
message("✓ Helper function run_loocv() defined (LOPO: Leave-One-Patient-Out CV)")
```

```{r}
#| label: step10-s1-baseline-inflammation-recovery

message("\n=== SECONDARY S1: Baseline Inflammation → Recovery Distance ===")

# ============================================================
# Research Question S1 (SECONDARY):
# Patienten mit erhöhter Baseline-Inflammation zeigen verzögerte/
# unvollständige Recovery bei V2
#
# Literatur: Schmader et al. 2021 (BMC Cardiovasc Disord)
# Hypothese: Baseline inflammation ist assoziiert mit recovery trajectory
# ============================================================

# Daten: Patient-level, brauchen Baseline (A) und V2
clinical_data_s1 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V2")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, clinical_inflammation_score,
                age, sex, log_euroscore_ii) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = clinical_inflammation_score,
              names_prefix = "inflam_") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(inflam_A), !is.na(inflam_V2)) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_inflam = inflam_A,
    recovery_distance = abs(inflam_V2 - inflam_A)
  )

message(sprintf("  n = %d patients with complete A + V2 data", nrow(clinical_data_s1)))

# Stop-Regel: Mindestens 20 vollständige Fälle
if (nrow(clinical_data_s1) < 20) {
  message("⚠️ STOP: n < 20 → S1 wird nur deskriptiv berichtet")
  clinical_s1_run <- FALSE
} else {
  clinical_s1_run <- TRUE
}

if (clinical_s1_run) {
  # Modell: Recovery distance ~ Baseline inflammation + covariates
  # Adjustierung: minimal (age, sex, Euroscore)
  clinical_model_s1 <- lm(
    recovery_distance ~ baseline_inflam + age + sex + log_euroscore_ii,
    data = clinical_data_s1
  )

  # Extrahiere Results
  clinical_results_s1 <- extract_model_results(
    clinical_model_s1,
    term_of_interest = "baseline_inflam",
    model_name = "S1_Baseline_Inflammation_Recovery"
  )

  message("\n--- S1 MODEL SUMMARY ---")
  message(sprintf("  n = %d", clinical_results_s1$n))
  message("\n  Coefficients:")
  print(clinical_results_s1$coefficients)

  # VIF Check
  if (!is.null(clinical_results_s1$vif)) {
    max_vif <- max(clinical_results_s1$vif)
    if (max_vif > clinical_params$vif_threshold) {
      message(sprintf("⚠️ VIF WARNING: max VIF = %.2f (threshold = %.1f)",
                      max_vif, clinical_params$vif_threshold))
    } else {
      message(sprintf("✓ VIF OK: max VIF = %.2f", max_vif))
    }
  }

  # Effect size: Standardized coefficient
  clinical_s1_effect <- clinical_data_s1 %>%
    summarise(
      cor_baseline_recovery = cor(baseline_inflam, recovery_distance, use = "complete.obs"),
      sd_baseline = sd(baseline_inflam, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_recovery = sd(recovery_distance, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  message(sprintf("\n  Effect: r = %.3f (Pearson correlation)",
                  clinical_s1_effect$cor_baseline_recovery))

  # Speichere
  saveRDS(clinical_results_s1, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "secondary_s1_results.rds"))
  message("💾 S1 Results saved")

} else {
  clinical_results_s1 <- NULL
  message("⚠️ S1 analysis skipped (insufficient n)")
}
```

```{r}
  clinical_data_s2 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%

    clinical_s2_interaction <- FALSE

    )

  # Extrahiere Results

    clinical_model_s2,
```
