```{r}
#| label: step10-secondary-summary-multiple-testing
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n=== SECONDARY ANALYSES: Summary & Multiple Testing Correction (BH-FDR) ===")

# ============================================================
# Konsolidiere alle Secondary Results
# Appliziere Benjamini-Hochberg FDR über gesamtes Secondary-Set
# Entscheidung: BH-FDR (weniger konservativ als Holm, angemessen für Secondary)
# ============================================================

# Extrahiere Key P-Values aus allen Secondary Analyses
clinical_secondary_tests <- list()

# S1: Baseline Inflammation → Recovery (linear model, key term: baseline_inflam)
if (!is.null(clinical_results_s1)) {
  s1_pval <- clinical_results_s1$coefficients %>%
    filter(term == "baseline_inflam") %>%
    pull(p.value)
  if (length(s1_pval) > 0) {
    clinical_secondary_tests$S1 <- list(
      name = "S1_Baseline_Inflammation_Recovery",
      description = "Baseline inflammation is associated with recovery distance (V2-A)",
      p_value = s1_pval
    )
  }
}

# S2: Ribosome × GFR (mixed model, key term: interaction or main effect)
if (!is.null(clinical_results_s2)) {
  # Prüfe ob Interaktion vorhanden
  s2_coefs <- clinical_results_s2$coefficients
  if ("timepointV2:GFR_impairedimpaired" %in% s2_coefs$term) {
    s2_pval <- s2_coefs %>%
      filter(term == "timepointV2:GFR_impairedimpaired") %>%
      pull(p.value)
    s2_term <- "Interaction timepoint × GFR"
  } else if ("GFR_impairedimpaired" %in% s2_coefs$term) {
    s2_pval <- s2_coefs %>%
      filter(term == "GFR_impairedimpaired") %>%
      pull(p.value)
    s2_term <- "Main effect GFR"
  } else {
    s2_pval <- NA
    s2_term <- "N/A"
  }

  if (!is.na(s2_pval)) {
    clinical_secondary_tests$S2 <- list(
      name = "S2_Ribosome_GFR",
      description = paste0("Ribosome recovery × GFR (", s2_term, ")"),
      p_value = s2_pval
    )
  }
}

# S3: TF Stress Signatures (mixed model, test timepoint effect)
if (!is.null(clinical_results_s3)) {
  # Key test: Zeitverlauf (timepointV1 oder timepointV2)
  s3_coefs <- clinical_results_s3$coefficients
  s3_timepoint_terms <- s3_coefs %>%
    filter(grepl("^timepoint", term))

  if (nrow(s3_timepoint_terms) > 0) {
    # Nimm kleinsten p-Wert der Zeitpunkt-Terms (konservativ: würde Bonferroni rechtfertigen)
    s3_pval <- min(s3_timepoint_terms$p.value, na.rm = TRUE)
    clinical_secondary_tests$S3 <- list(
      name = "S3_TF_Stress_Signatures",
      description = "TF stress score temporal dynamics",
      p_value = s3_pval
    )
  }
}

# S4: AF × Inflammation (mixed model)
if (!is.null(clinical_results_s4)) {
  s4_coefs <- clinical_results_s4$coefficients
  # Prüfe Interaktion, sonst Haupteffekt
  if (any(grepl(":af", s4_coefs$term))) {
    s4_interaction_terms <- s4_coefs %>%
      filter(grepl(":af", term))
    s4_pval <- min(s4_interaction_terms$p.value, na.rm = TRUE)
    s4_term <- "Interaction timepoint × AF"
  } else if ("afAF" %in% s4_coefs$term) {
    s4_pval <- s4_coefs %>%
      filter(term == "afAF") %>%
      pull(p.value)
    s4_term <- "Main effect AF"
  } else {
    s4_pval <- NA
    s4_term <- "N/A"
  }

  if (!is.na(s4_pval)) {
    clinical_secondary_tests$S4 <- list(
      name = "S4_AF_Inflammation",
      description = paste0("AF × Inflammation trajectory (", s4_term, ")"),
      p_value = s4_pval
    )
  }
}

# Erstelle Summary-Tabelle
if (length(clinical_secondary_tests) > 0) {
  clinical_secondary_summary <- data.frame(
    Analysis = sapply(clinical_secondary_tests, function(x) x$name),
    Description = sapply(clinical_secondary_tests, function(x) x$description),
    raw_p = sapply(clinical_secondary_tests, function(x) x$p_value),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # BH-FDR Korrektur
  clinical_secondary_summary <- clinical_secondary_summary %>%
    mutate(
      fdr_bh = p.adjust(raw_p, method = "BH"),
      sig_raw = case_when(
        raw_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        raw_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        raw_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      sig_fdr = case_when(
        fdr_bh < 0.001 ~ "***",
        fdr_bh < 0.01 ~ "**",
        fdr_bh < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )

  message("\n=== SECONDARY ANALYSES: Summary (BH-FDR Corrected) ===")
  safe_print(clinical_secondary_summary, row.names = FALSE)

  # Speichere
  write.csv(
    clinical_secondary_summary,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_analyses_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  message("\n💾 Secondary Summary saved")

  # Interpretation
  n_sig_raw <- sum(clinical_secondary_summary$raw_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_sig_fdr <- sum(clinical_secondary_summary$fdr_bh < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

  message(sprintf(
    "\n✓ SIGNIFIKANTE BEFUNDE (Secondary): %d/%d (raw), %d/%d (FDR-corrected)",
    n_sig_raw, nrow(clinical_secondary_summary),
    n_sig_fdr, nrow(clinical_secondary_summary)
  ))

} else {
  message("⚠️ Keine Secondary Analyses durchgeführt (Daten nicht verfügbar)")
  clinical_secondary_summary <- NULL
}

message("\n✓ SECONDARY ANALYSES (Schritt 10) KOMPLETT")
```

```{r}
#| label: step11-e1-valve-type-acute-inflammation
#| echo: false

message("\n=== EXPLORATORY E1: Valve Type × Acute Inflammation (V1-A) ===")

# ============================================================
# Research Question E1 (EXPLORATORY):
# Unterscheiden sich SEV vs BEV in der akuten Inflammationsantwort?
#
# WICHTIG: Nicht randomisiert → Selection Bias (Anatomie, Risiko)
# Klassifikation: EXPLORATORY (Confounding-Risiko hoch)
# ============================================================

# Prüfe ob Valve-Type verfügbar
clinical_has_valve <- "valve_type_grouped" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete)

if (!clinical_has_valve) {
  message("⚠️ Valve Type nicht verfügbar → E1 übersprungen")
  clinical_e1_run <- FALSE
  clinical_results_e1 <- NULL
} else {
  # Delta-Analyse: V1-A für Inflammation
  # (Vermeidet longitudinales Modell, einfacher bei kleinen n)

  clinical_data_e1_wide <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
    filter(!is.na(valve_type_grouped), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, valve_type_grouped, clinical_inflammation_score,
                  age, sex, log_euroscore_ii) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = clinical_inflammation_score,
                names_prefix = "inflam_") %>%
    filter(!is.na(inflam_A), !is.na(inflam_V1)) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_V1_A = inflam_V1 - inflam_A
    )

  message(sprintf("  n = %d patients with complete data", nrow(clinical_data_e1_wide)))

  # Zellenbesetzung
  clinical_e1_n_by_valve <- table(clinical_data_e1_wide$valve_type_grouped)
  message("\n--- E1 GROUP SIZES ---")
  print(clinical_e1_n_by_valve)

  # Stop-Regel: Kleinste Gruppe < min_n_subgroup (konsistent mit anderen Analysen)
  if (min(clinical_e1_n_by_valve) < clinical_params$min_n_subgroup) {
    message(sprintf("⚠️ STOP: Kleinste Gruppe n = %d < %d → nur deskriptiv",
                    min(clinical_e1_n_by_valve), clinical_params$min_n_subgroup))
    clinical_e1_run <- FALSE
  } else {
    # Modell: Delta ~ Valve Type + Confounder
    # WICHTIG: Dokumentiere als explorativ, nicht adjustiert für alle Confounder
    clinical_model_e1 <- lm(
      delta_V1_A ~ valve_type_grouped + age + sex + log_euroscore_ii,
      data = clinical_data_e1_wide
    )

    clinical_results_e1 <- extract_model_results(
      clinical_model_e1,
      term_of_interest = "valve_type",
      model_name = "E1_Valve_Type_Acute_Inflammation"
    )

    message("\n--- E1 MODEL SUMMARY (EXPLORATORY) ---")
    message("⚠️ CAUTION: Non-randomized comparison → potential confounding")
    print(clinical_results_e1$coefficients)

    # VIF
    if (!is.null(clinical_results_e1$vif)) {
      message(sprintf("  VIF: max = %.2f", max(clinical_results_e1$vif)))
    }

    # Deskriptiv
    clinical_e1_descriptive <- clinical_data_e1_wide %>%
      group_by(valve_type_grouped) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_delta = mean(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_delta = sd(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    message("\n  Descriptive Stats:")
    print(clinical_e1_descriptive)

    # Speichere
    saveRDS(clinical_results_e1, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "exploratory_e1_results.rds"))
    message("💾 E1 Results saved (EXPLORATORY)")

    clinical_e1_run <- TRUE
  }

  if (!clinical_e1_run) {
    clinical_results_e1 <- NULL
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| warning: false

message("\n=== EXPLORATORY E2: Sex × Recovery Normalization (V2-V1) ===")

# ============================================================
# Research Question E2 (EXPLORATORY):
# Geschlechtsunterschiede in der Inflammations-Recovery
#
# Literatur: Bekannte Sex-Unterschiede in Immunantworten
# Klassifikation: EXPLORATORY (interessant, aber Stichprobe ggf. unbalanciert)
# ============================================================

# Delta-Analyse: V2-V1 für Inflammation (Recovery-Phase)
clinical_data_e2_wide <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, sex, clinical_inflammation_score, age, log_euroscore_ii) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = clinical_inflammation_score,
              names_prefix = "inflam_") %>%
  filter(!is.na(inflam_V1), !is.na(inflam_V2)) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_V2_V1 = inflam_V2 - inflam_V1
  )

message(sprintf("  n = %d patients with complete V1+V2 data", nrow(clinical_data_e2_wide)))

# Zellenbesetzung
clinical_e2_n_by_sex <- table(clinical_data_e2_wide$sex)
message("\n--- E2 GROUP SIZES ---")
print(clinical_e2_n_by_sex)

# Stop-Regel: Kleinste Gruppe < 10
if (min(clinical_e2_n_by_sex) < 10) {
  message(sprintf("⚠️ STOP: Kleinste Gruppe n = %d < 10 → nur deskriptiv",
                  min(clinical_e2_n_by_sex)))
  clinical_e2_run <- FALSE
  clinical_results_e2 <- NULL
} else {
  # Modell: Delta ~ Sex + Age + Euroscore
  clinical_model_e2 <- lm(
    delta_V2_V1 ~ sex + age + log_euroscore_ii,
    data = clinical_data_e2_wide
  )

  clinical_results_e2 <- extract_model_results(
    clinical_model_e2,
    term_of_interest = "sex",
    model_name = "E2_Sex_Recovery"
  )

  message("\n--- E2 MODEL SUMMARY (EXPLORATORY) ---")
  print(clinical_results_e2$coefficients)

  # Deskriptiv
  clinical_e2_descriptive <- clinical_data_e2_wide %>%
    group_by(sex) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_delta = mean(delta_V2_V1, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_delta = sd(delta_V2_V1, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  message("\n  Descriptive Stats:")
  print(clinical_e2_descriptive)

  # Speichere
  saveRDS(clinical_results_e2, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "exploratory_e2_results.rds"))
  message("💾 E2 Results saved (EXPLORATORY)")

  clinical_e2_run <- TRUE
}
```

```{r}
#| label: step11-e3-ifn-signatures
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n=== EXPLORATORY E3: Interferon Signatures × Clinical Status ===")

# ============================================================
# Research Question E3 (EXPLORATORY):
# IFN-Response-Signaturen bei Baseline (A) und klinische Charakteristika
#
# Literatur: Schmader et al. 2021 (IFN-Composite-Score)
# Klassifikation: EXPLORATORY (Cross-sectional, nur Baseline)
# ============================================================

# Prüfe ob IFN-Composite-Score verfügbar (aus Step 6 GSVA)
clinical_has_ifn <- "clinical_interferon_score" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical_complete)

if (!clinical_has_ifn) {
  message("⚠️ IFN-Composite-Score nicht verfügbar → E3 übersprungen")
  clinical_e3_run <- FALSE
  clinical_results_e3 <- NULL
} else {
  # Nutze clinical_interferon_score (Composite aus IFN-α + IFN-γ Hallmarks)
  clinical_data_e3 <- sample_meta_clinical_complete %>%
    dplyr::filter(timepoint == "A") %>%  # Nur Baseline
    dplyr::rename(ifn_composite = clinical_interferon_score) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ifn_composite), !is.na(atrial_fibrillation_flutter), !is.na(diabetes))

  message(sprintf("  n = %d patients at Baseline (A)", nrow(clinical_data_e3)))

  # Modell: IFN-Score ~ AF + Diabetes + Age + Sex
  # (AF und Diabetes = chronische Inflammationszustände)
  clinical_model_e3 <- lm(
    ifn_composite ~ atrial_fibrillation_flutter + diabetes + age + sex,
    data = clinical_data_e3
  )

  clinical_results_e3 <- extract_model_results(
    clinical_model_e3,
    term_of_interest = NULL,
    model_name = "E3_IFN_Signatures_Baseline"
  )

  message("\n--- E3 MODEL SUMMARY (EXPLORATORY) ---")
  message("⚠️ Cross-sectional Baseline only → limited temporal inference")
  print(clinical_results_e3$coefficients)

  # VIF
  if (!is.null(clinical_results_e3$vif)) {
    message(sprintf("  VIF: max = %.2f", max(clinical_results_e3$vif)))
  }

  # Speichere
  saveRDS(clinical_results_e3, file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "exploratory_e3_results.rds"))
  message("💾 E3 Results saved (EXPLORATORY)")

  clinical_e3_run <- TRUE
}
```

```{r}
#| label: step11-exploratory-summary
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n=== EXPLORATORY ANALYSES: Summary ===")

# ============================================================
# Konsolidiere alle Exploratory Results
# KEINE Multiple Testing Correction (hypothesis-generating)
# ============================================================

clinical_exploratory_tests <- list()

# E1: Valve Type
if (!is.null(clinical_results_e1)) {
  e1_coef <- clinical_results_e1$coefficients %>%
    filter(grepl("valve_type", term))
  if (nrow(e1_coef) > 0) {
    clinical_exploratory_tests$E1 <- list(
      name = "E1_Valve_Type",
      description = "Valve Type × Acute Inflammation (non-randomized)",
      p_value = min(e1_coef$p.value, na.rm = TRUE),
      caution = "Selection bias possible"
    )
  }
}

# E2: Sex
if (!is.null(clinical_results_e2)) {
  e2_coef <- clinical_results_e2$coefficients %>%
    filter(term == "sexmale")
  if (nrow(e2_coef) > 0) {
    clinical_exploratory_tests$E2 <- list(
      name = "E2_Sex_Recovery",
      description = "Sex differences in inflammation recovery (V2-V1)",
      p_value = e2_coef$p.value,
      caution = "Hormone status not captured"
    )
  }
}

# E3: IFN
if (!is.null(clinical_results_e3)) {
  e3_coefs <- clinical_results_e3$coefficients %>%
    filter(term %in% c("atrial_fibrillation_flutter", "diabetes"))
  if (nrow(e3_coefs) > 0) {
    clinical_exploratory_tests$E3 <- list(
      name = "E3_IFN_Baseline",
      description = "IFN signatures × clinical status (Baseline only)",
      p_value = min(e3_coefs$p.value, na.rm = TRUE),
      caution = "Cross-sectional, no temporal dynamics"
    )
  }
}

# Summary-Tabelle
if (length(clinical_exploratory_tests) > 0) {
  clinical_exploratory_summary <- data.frame(
    Analysis = sapply(clinical_exploratory_tests, function(x) x$name),
    Description = sapply(clinical_exploratory_tests, function(x) x$description),
    raw_p = sapply(clinical_exploratory_tests, function(x) x$p_value),
    Caution = sapply(clinical_exploratory_tests, function(x) x$caution),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Signifikanz-Symbole (NUR für Orientation, KEINE adjustierte p-Werte)
  clinical_exploratory_summary <- clinical_exploratory_summary %>%
    mutate(
      sig_raw = case_when(
        raw_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        raw_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        raw_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )

  message("\n=== EXPLORATORY ANALYSES: Summary (NO Multiple Testing Correction) ===")
  message("⚠️ INTERPRETATION: Hypothesis-generating only, requires replication")
  safe_print(clinical_exploratory_summary, row.names = FALSE)

  # Speichere
  write.csv(
    clinical_exploratory_summary,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_analyses_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  message("\n💾 Exploratory Summary saved")

} else {
  message("⚠️ Keine Exploratory Analyses durchgeführt (Daten nicht verfügbar)")
  clinical_exploratory_summary <- NULL
}

message("\n✓ EXPLORATORY ANALYSES (Schritt 11) KOMPLETT")
```
